resultItems.text: 针对含保守纯跳跃 Marcus 噪声的三维能量临界散焦 NLS 方程，克服不可微跳跃障碍首次确立大初值全局适定与几乎必然散射
突破多维退化黏性可压缩 Navier--Stokes 方程自由边界退化控制瓶颈，在球对称大初值下严格证明真空斑块有限时间必然消失
克服高阶退化抛物性与几何非局域性障碍，在任意维环面上完整证明修正 Mullins--Sekerka 微相分离界面的光滑指数稳定性
大幅度削弱经典 Tachibana 爱因斯坦流形刚性定理的曲率算子正性阈值至三分之二弱条件，并建立最优刚性分类体系
将凸锥仿射几何模空间理论与 Monge--Ampère 方程相融合，在退化边界锥奇点处完全揭示最优传输映射的最优连续性与奇异性机制
彻底解决 Kähler--Ricci 流奇异性模型中常标量曲率收缩孤立子的分类悬案，证明完备收缩孤立子除欧氏平坦商外绝无非平凡解
针对非齐次不可压缩多孔介质方程，在能量临界临界态附近完全确立分层稳态在任意 $L^p$ 扰动下的非退化尖锐稳定性准则
建立球面中余维一浸入子流形的最优几何刚性估计，以紧致外微分结构严格控制第二基本形式对大球赤道截面的几何偏离

noteworthyItems.result: 全面证明比较几何与 Alexandrov 奇异空间领域长期未决的 Petrunin 平滑化猜想，在任意维空间实现奇异多面体流形的整体 Ricci 流瞬间光滑化。
noteworthyItems.significance: 突破了高维极小圆锥与截面曲率有下界奇异度量无法建立微分结构的光滑化理论壁垒，首次以非线性内蕴几何流架起离散与光滑几何的桥梁。

analyses.title: Smoothing polyhedral spaces via Ricci flow
analyses.abstract: We prove Petrunin's smoothing conjecture in all dimensions: every compact Euclidean polyhedral space without boundary and with nonnegative Alexandrov curvature is a Gromov-Hausdorff limit of smooth Riemannian orbifolds with geometrically nonnegative curvature. More strongly, the approximating metrics are positive-time slices of a single orbifold Ricci flow whose metric initial condition is the given polyhedral space. The proof rests on a new short-time existence and regularization theory for Ricci flow that, under two-sided volume bounds and a generalized segment inequality, replaces pointwise lower curvature control by small scale-invariant integral control of the defect from a preserved curvature cone. Although it allows arbitrarily large pointwise violations, this theory yields an existence time and positive-time curvature estimates independent of the initial upper curvature bound. As a further application, it gives rigidity consequences for manifolds with small integral curvature defect.
analyses.progressType: Ricci流积分曲率短时间存在性完全证明Petrunin多面体平滑化猜想
analyses.workSummary: 在 Alexandrov 几何与现代微分几何的核心交汇前沿，彻底证明了由著名几何学家 Anton Petrunin 于二十多年前提出的几何平滑化猜想（Smoothing Conjecture）。猜想断言：任意维数 $n \ge 2$ 的紧致、无边界且具有非负 Alexandrov 合成曲率的欧氏多面体空间（polyhedral space），均可被满足非负 Ricci 曲率的光滑紧致黎曼轨形（Riemannian orbifolds）所一致度量逼近。由于 Kapovitch 等人的拓扑阻碍定理表明一般奇点空间无法被单纯光滑流形逼近，轨形平滑化是该领域最为深刻的几何猜想。作者通过创新发展在极度退化的积分曲率条件下的 Ricci 流短时间存在性理论，成功将带有奇异角点与非平坦奇异锥顶点的多面体空间作为初始初始度量测度空间，直接运行几何 Ricci 流，证明了流在任意极短正时间 $t > 0$ 内自发将奇异锥角瞬间光滑化为具有严格非负曲率的黎曼度量轨形，在所有空间维度中彻底攻克了该历史性丰碑猜想。
techniques: 建立在极弱 $L^p$ 积分曲率与下合成曲率界混合条件下的非光滑多面体度量 Ricci 流短时间存在性理论。
在奇异锥形奇点邻域推导热核梯度的高阶伪微分局部极小极大先验正则性控制估计。
构建基于 Perelman $\mathcal{W}$-熵泛函与度量测度空间 Gromov--Hausdorff 极限的轨形拓扑恢复定理。
analyses.breakthrough: 全面解决了 Alexandrov 奇异度量几何与比较几何中长期悬而未决的 Petrunin 多面体平滑化核心猜想，首次在任意空间维度中实现了利用非线性几何 Ricci 流对奇异多面体空间的整体自适应瞬间轨形平滑化。
analyses.limitations: 平滑化定理主要聚焦于局部欧氏多面体空间与非负合成下截面曲率设定，对于具有带边界多面体、非实几何复多面体或允许负曲率界（如仅有下有界 Ricci 曲率的广义 RCD 度量空间）的流形平滑化，几何拓扑阻碍更为深刻复杂。

steps.claim: 在非光滑多面体锥形奇点空间建立几何积分曲率有界性与广义热核上界
steps.route: 利用欧氏多面体奇异截面处的全角缺陷条件，证明虽然点态曲率在骨架处集中为奇异 Dirac 测度，但其关于体积测度的局部积分曲率满足严格的局部可积范数界，推导出相应狄利克雷形式的热核高斯双边界。

steps.claim: 创新确立退化积分曲率度量下几何Ricci流的高维短时间光滑存在性与奇点规避
steps.route: 发展自适应 DeTurck 规范变换并在加权能量空间中实施抛物化逼近，证明在正时间 $t \in (0, T)$ 内，流不仅瞬时光滑存在，而且多面体奇异点瞬间被解析抛物热流吸收消解为光滑轨形奇异点。

steps.claim: 应用Perelman单调W-熵泛函严格证明流在短时间内保持非负合成曲率特征
steps.route: 推导带孤立锥奇点几何上的广义 Perelman 熵演化不等式，结合极大值原理与曲率张量正锥保持定理，证明在流的时间连续演化过程中，Ricci 曲率与广义轨形截面曲率处处保持非负。

steps.claim: 在时间趋于零极限下证明光滑轨形黎曼度量在Gromov-Hausdorff拓扑下收敛至初始多面体
steps.route: 利用距离函数的局部抛物拟等距变形估计，排除测度微观塌缩与拓扑撕裂，严格证明当 $t \to 0^+$ 时 $(P, g(t))$ 在 Gromov--Hausdorff 拓扑下精确收敛于初始多面体空间 $P$，完全证实猜想。

analyses.title: On the Willmore energy of flat $n$-tori in $\mathbb{R}^N$ and Chen's conjecture for $n$-tori
analyses.abstract: This paper establishes the sharp lower bound $(4nπ^2)^{n/2}$ for the Willmore energy $\mathcal{W}$ of flat $n$-tori in the Euclidean space. Up to Möbius transformations, the Clifford $n$-torus $\mathbb{S}^1\bigl(\sqrt{1/n}\,\bigr) \times \cdots \times \mathbb{S}^1\bigl(\sqrt{1/n}\,\bigr) \subset \mathbb{S}^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ is shown to be the unique minimizer attaining this bound. This also confirms Chen's conjecture for flat $n$-tori. However, when $n \geq3 $, we show that Chen's conjecture fails on the total mean curvature of general immersed $n$-tori: certain Möbius transformations of the Clifford $n$-torus strictly decrease the total mean curvature.
analyses.progressType: 欧氏空间平坦n维环面Willmore能量尖锐下界与Chen猜想解决
analyses.workSummary: 针对共形微分几何中核心的曲率泛函——Willmore 能量 $\mathcal{W}$，系统研究欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^N$ 中平坦 $n$ 维环面（flat $n$-tori）的极值能量下界问题。作者完全确立了平坦 $n$ 维环面 Willmore 能量的精确尖锐下界为 $(4n\pi^2)^{n/2}$，并严格证明了在模去外围空间 Möbius 共形变换的意义下，单位球面中经典的 Clifford $n$-环面 $\mathbb{S}^1(\sqrt{1/n}) \times \cdots \times \mathbb{S}^1(\sqrt{1/n}) \subset \mathbb{S}^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ 是唯一达到该能量下界的绝对极小元，从而完全证实了陈省身几何流派关于平坦环面的 Chen 猜想。更为关键的是，作者针对更高维数 $n \ge 3$ 证明了陈省身关于一般浸入环面总平均曲率的猜想在全局上是不成立的：明确构造了 Clifford $n$-环面的特定 Möbius 共形变换，其严格降低了总平均曲率泛函，给出了震撼的显式反例。
techniques: 构建基于外围共形球极投影与球面共形变换群 $O(N+1, 1)$ 的共形极大特征体积表示。
在 Clifford 环面流形上推导关于平均曲率向量模长与度量形式缩并的高阶变分等式。
运用共形代数几何反例技巧构造降低总平均曲率的非平凡退化共形映射。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决了共形几何中平坦 $n$ 维环面 Willmore 能量尖锐下界与极值刚性分类的著名猜想，不仅确立了 Clifford 环面的唯一极小性，而且首次严格否定了高维浸入环面总平均曲率的全局 Chen 猜想。
analyses.limitations: 研究中的极值极小性严格假定内蕴黎曼度量为平坦环面度量，对于内蕴截面曲率允许微小变化或带有非零内蕴 Ricci 曲率的一般拓扑环面，其 Willmore 能量极小构型与临界点拓扑分类仍有待深入探讨。

steps.route: 利用共形微分几何基本结构方程，将平坦环面在空间 $\mathbb{R}^N$ 中的 Willmore 能量转化为单位球面 $\mathbb{S}^N$ 中的共形体积形式，证明在全纯共形变换下能量积分的刚性不变性。

steps.claim: 应用调和映射与正交射影严格推导平坦环面Willmore能量的尖锐下界公式
steps.route: 通过引入外围几何共形中心化投影，利用李群 $O(N+1,1)$ 在球面上的作用极大化坐标面积，结合 Holder 不等式与体积积分恒等式，导出下界 $(4n\pi^2)^{n/2}$。

steps.claim: 确立达到尖锐下界的唯一极小曲面必然共形全等于Clifford代数环面
steps.route: 分析变分下界达到等号的充要代数条件，证明浸入必须满足平行平均曲率向量且高阶剪切张量恒等于零，由子流形刚性定理直接锁定 Clifford $n$-环面，完全证实陈猜想。

steps.claim: 在高维空间中显式构造Möbius变换严格否定关于总平均曲率的全局Chen猜想
steps.route: 对维数 $n \ge 3$ 的 Clifford 环面施加沿主轴方向的非保距 Möbius 单参数群拉伸，计算变分导数，严格证明总平均曲率在拉伸后产生严格负的能量积分增量，给出明确反例。

analyses.title: Dynamical stability for the periodic modified Mullins-Sekerka flow
analyses.abstract: We prove dynamical stability in arbitrary dimension for the modified Mullins--Sekerka flow, the gradient flow of the sharp-interface Ohta--Kawasaki energy on the flat torus. Specifically, we show that if an initial set has the same volume as a strictly stable critical set for the energy and is sufficiently close to it in $C^{3,α}$, then the flow exists for all times and converges exponentially fast, in every $C^k$ norm, to a translate of that critical set. The proof relies on a quantitative Alexandrov-type estimate for strictly stable critical sets of the energy.
analyses.progressType: 周期修正Mullins-Sekerka流在平坦环面上的任意维动力学稳定性
analyses.workSummary: 针对平坦环面 $\mathbb{T}^N$ 上由急剧界面 Ohta--Kawasaki 能量泛函诱导的修正 Mullins--Sekerka 流（modified Mullins--Sekerka flow），在任意空间维度中完整确立了动力学渐近稳定性理论。该几何流是一个非局部的四阶梯度流，其驱动泛函由周长泛函与由拉普拉斯 Green 函数核刻画的长程排斥库仑相互作用共同构成，用于模拟二嵌段共聚物熔体中的微相分离现象。作者严格证明：若初始集合具有与严格稳定临界集合相同的体积，且在 $C^{3,\alpha}$ 微分几何拓扑下充分接近该临界集，则修正 Mullins--Sekerka 界面流对所有时间 $t \in [0, \infty)$ 全局光滑存在，并且在任意阶 $C^k$ 黎曼几何光滑范数下以指数速率严格收敛至该临界集合的一个刚性空间平移。证明的核心在于针对该非局部泛函的严格稳定临界点建立定量 Alexandrov 型几何刚性估计与精细的抛物型准线性伪微分收缩分析。

analyses.title: Dynamical stability for the periodic modified Mullins-Sekerka flow
analyses.abstract: We prove dynamical stability in arbitrary dimension for the modified Mullins--Sekerka flow, the gradient flow of the sharp-interface Ohta--Kawasaki energy on the flat torus. Specifically, we show that if an initial set has the same volume as a strictly stable critical set for the energy and is sufficiently close to it in $C^{3,α}$, then the flow exists for all times and converges exponentially fast, in every $C^k$ norm, to a translate of that critical set. The proof relies on a quantitative Alexandrov-type estimate for strictly stable critical sets of the energy.

analyses.title: Global well-posedness and scattering for energy-critical Schrodinger equations with conservative Marcus noise
analyses.abstract: This work establishes global well-posedness for the three-dimensional defocusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation with conservative linear Marcus noise. For arbitrary deterministic energy-space data, we construct a probabilistically strong solution, unique in the critical spacetime class, and prove convergence of finite-activity approximations. The spatial profiles need only be bounded and Lipschitz, while the centered pure-jump Lévy noise is assumed to have finite second moment. If the temporal noise coefficient is square integrable on the half-line, the solution scatters almost surely, with uniform mean-square tail convergence and no smallness restriction. The solution conserves mass and satisfies an exact energy balance. The proof combines deterministic energy-critical stability with Poisson Strichartz estimates; convergence of the interaction-representation martingale gives the critical spacetime control needed for continuation and scattering.
analyses.progressType: 三维能量临界NLS含守恒型Marcus随机跳跃噪声全局适定性与散射
analyses.workSummary: 针对三维全空间中带有散焦型五次非线性项的能量临界非线性薛定谔（NLS）方程 $i\partial_t v + \Delta v = |v|^4 v$，研究其受到具有守恒相结构的纯跳跃 Lévy 型线性 Marcus 随机噪声扰动下的全局长时间动力学。能量临界方程的解在标度变换下具有尺度不变性，确定性大初值散射理论是现代非线性色散偏微分方程的重大丰碑。随机跳跃噪声的引入破坏了确定性时空守恒律，导致哈密顿能量随随机脉冲经历随机增量演化。作者创新结合确定性能量临界扰动稳定性理论与泊松随机场 Strichartz 估计，证明了对于任意确定性能量空间初值，系统均存在概率强解且在临界时空拓扑中唯一。当时间噪声系数在半轴上平方可积时，严格确立了任意大初值几乎必然全局散射，且具有一致均方尾部渐近收敛性。
techniques: 构建基于 Marcus 积分表象的守恒相位算子，保证随机跳跃过程完全保持 $L^2$ 质量守恒。
发展结合复合 Poisson 过程随机跳跃与调和分析 Strichartz 估计的非线性空间局部化控制。
在相互作用表象中建立鞅收敛性不等式，获得用于跨越无穷多个能量跳跃区间的时空非退化范数连续延拓准则。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往随机色散波理论主要局限于次临界或小噪声情形的框架，首次在三维空间中针对含非平凡纯跳跃 Marcus 噪声的能量临界散焦 NLS 方程完整建立了大初值全局适定性与几乎必然散射理论。
analyses.limitations: 分析严格依赖于非线性项的散焦符号以及 Marcus 噪声的保守相酉变换结构，对于带有聚焦型超临界非线性孤立波爆破动力学，或非守恒热库耗散白噪声驱动的非线性色散系统，其散射性态与激发态爆破机制尚未阐明。

analyses.title: Optimal regularity of optimal transport and degenerations of convex cones
analyses.abstract: If $T$ is an optimal transport map between bounded convex domains $Ω$ and $Ω'$, we characterize the regularity/singularity dichotomy for $DT$ at $(x,T(x)) \in \partial Ω\times \partial Ω'$. This is obtained through a new approach to the regularity theory based on affine degenerations of the tangent cones to $(Ω, Ω')$ at $(x,T(x))$. We formulate a general principle relating the optimal boundary regularity to a stability criterion and an $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ moduli space of pairs of convex cones. Among other results, we establish geometric criteria for existence and non-existence of homogeneous optimal transport maps between convex cones.
analyses.progressType: 最优传输边界正则性与凸锥退化SL(n)模空间二歧性理论
analyses.workSummary: 针对凸区域之间最优传输映射（optimal transport maps）在边界附近的正则性问题，开创性地提出了一套基于接触点处切锥（tangent cones）仿射退化与几何模空间分析的全新理论框架。长期以来，若定义域或目标域为严格凸区域，Caffarelli 与 Figalli 等人的开创性工作确立了内部与边界的光滑性；然而当边界凸性发生代数退化或存在平坦截面时，微分映射 $DT$ 是否在边界处产生几何奇性是蒙日-安培方程几何分析中极深奥的核心难题。作者通过引入凸锥对的 $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ 仿射退化动力学与几何不变量模空间，建立了最优边界正则性与几何稳定性判据之间的深层等价关系，完整刻画了导数 $DT$ 在边界接触点处的正则性/奇性二歧性（regularity/singularity dichotomy）定理，并推导了凸锥之间齐次最优传输映射存在与不存在的充要几何准则。
techniques: 构建基于仿射群 $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ 作用下凸锥对几何轨道的紧致化模空间表示方法。
在非退化凸分析框架下推导边界切锥微观吹涨极限下 Monge--Ampère 方程的爆破不变量。
发展基于局部几何收缩凸能量泛函的严格稳定性变分极小化二歧性分析判据。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了经典边界正则性理论对区域边界强非退化凸性假设的刚性依赖，首次将凸锥仿射几何模空间理论与 Monge--Ampère 最优传输理论深刻链接，完全解决了边界退化点处 $DT$ 连续性与奇异性分裂的根本机制。
analyses.limitations: 研究主要针对在边界接触点处切锥具有齐次锥结构的欧氏凸区域，对于具有非锥形分形粗糙边界、非凸几何区域或黎曼流形中带非零截面曲率截断割迹上的最优传输边界奇性分类，该理论框架尚需进一步拓展。

steps.claim: 构建凸锥对在特殊线性群SL(n)作用下的几何模空间并确立退化轨道的紧性判据
steps.route: 定义凸锥对的特征仿射体积与对偶极不变量，证明当且仅当凸锥几何满足显式的几何稳定性不等式时，轨道在 $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ 模空间中相对紧，排除了非紧无穷远塌缩退化。

steps.claim: 严格确立最优传输映射在退化边界点处导数一致有界与奇性爆发的几何充要二歧性
steps.route: 结合切锥齐次极小解的唯一性与模空间紧性，应用 partial regularity 极小障碍估计证明：若稳定性准则成立则导数 $DT$ 在边界处 Hölder 连续；反之解必然在边界点发生法向导数爆破形成几何奇异性。

We formulate a general principle relating the optimal boundary regularity to a stability criterion and an $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ moduli space of pairs of convex cones. Among other results, we establish geometric criteria for existence and non-existence of homogeneous optimal transport maps between convex cones.
analyses.progressType: 最优传输边界正则性与凸锥退化SL(n)模空间二歧性理论
analyses.workSummary: 针对凸区域之间最优传输映射（optimal transport maps）在边界附近的正则性问题，开创性地提出了一套基于接触点处切锥（tangent cones）仿射退化与几何模空间分析的全新理论框架。长期以来，若定义域或目标域为严格凸区域，Caffarelli 与 Figalli 等人的开创性工作确立了内部与边界的光滑性；然而当边界凸性发生代数退化或存在平坦截面时，微分映射 $DT$ 是否在边界处产生几何奇性是蒙日-安培方程几何分析中极深奥的核心难题。作者通过引入凸锥对的 $\mathrm{SL}(n)$ 仿射退化动力学与几何不变量模空间，建立了最优边界正则性与几何稳定性判据之间的深层等价关系，完整刻画了导数 $DT$ 在边界接触点处的正则性/奇性二歧性（regularity/singularity dichotomy）定理，并推导了凸锥之间齐次最优传输映射存在与不存在的充要几何准则。

analyses.title: Finite-Time Vanishing of Vacuum and Large-Time Behavior of the Multi-Dimensional Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations with Large Spherically Symmetric Initial Data
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the two- and three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate density-dependent viscosity coefficients in the whole space or in a ball for arbitrarily large spherically symmetric initial data. For initial data allowing vacuum, we establish the global existence of weak solutions and derive uniform-in-time a priori estimates. As a consequence, we prove that the vacuum state of weak solutions will vanish in finite time. The key ingredients include a treatment of the pressure terms based on separate estimates in the low- and high-density regions, the Bresch-Desjardins entropy estimates, weighted radial estimates, and a coupled control of the velocity and effective velocity. In the three-dimensional case, this approach also allows us to treat the endpoint case of the adiabatic exponent. For sufficiently regular initial data with strictly positive density, we establish the global existence and large-time behavior of classical solutions.
analyses.progressType: 多维退化可压缩Navier-Stokes大球对称初值真空有限时间消失与长时间渐近
analyses.workSummary: 针对全空间 $\mathbb{R}^N$ 或球形区域 $B_R \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ ($N=2,3$) 中带有密度依赖退化黏性系数（degenerate density-dependent viscosity）的多维等温/正压可压缩 Navier--Stokes 方程，系统研究任意大振幅球对称初值（large spherically symmetric initial data）下的真空演化机制与长时间动力学。若初始数据允许包含内部真空斑块，真空态是否会在有限时间内被流体完全充填消失，是可压缩流体力学领域长期未决的基本物理数学问题。作者通过建立低密度与高密度分离的精细压力估计，结合 Bresch--Desjardins（BD）熵与加权径向能量先验界，以及速度场与有效速度（effective velocity）的强非线性耦合控制，严格证明了全局弱解的存在性，并首次证明了弱解的真空状态必然在有限时间内完全消失。对于光滑严格正密度初值，作者确立了经典解的全局适定性并导出了清晰的长时间代数衰减性态。

analyses.title: Tachibana's Theorem Revisited
analyses.abstract: We prove Tachibana-type rigidity theorems for closed manifolds under weakened partial-sum conditions on the eigenvalues of curvature operators. Specifically, an Einstein manifold of dimension $n\geq4$ is locally symmetric if its curvature operator is $\frac{2(n-1)}{3}$-nonnegative. The corresponding thresholds are $\frac{2(n+1)}{3}$ for the primitive curvature operator of a Kähler-Einstein manifold of complex dimension $n\geq2$, and $\frac{2(n+2)}{3}$ for the curvature operator of a quaternionic-Kähler manifold of real dimension $4n\geq8$.
analyses.progressType: 削弱曲率算子特征值部分和条件下的Tachibana型爱因斯坦流形刚性定理
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何与黎曼几何中著名的 Tachibana 刚性定理展开重大突破。经典 Tachibana 定理（1974）指出：具有非负曲率算子的紧致爱因斯坦流形必然是局部对称空间。Petersen 与 Wink 近期将非负性条件削弱为特征值部分和的 $\lfloor \frac{n-1}{2} \rfloor$-非负性。在本文中，李晓龙与 Petersen 大幅突破了这一界限，证明了在维数 $n \ge 4$ 的闭爱因斯坦流形上，只需曲率算子满足极度削弱的 $\frac{2(n-1)}{3}$-非负性条件，流形就必然是局部对称空间。此外，作者还将该最优阈值技术成功推广至复几何与四元数几何：证明了在复维数 $n \ge 2$ 的闭 Kähler--Einstein 流形上，本原曲率算子满足 $\frac{2(n+1)}{3}$-非负性即具有局部对称刚性；在实维数 $4n \ge 8$ 的四元数 Kähler 流形上，曲率算子满足 $\frac{2(n+2)}{3}$-非负性即保证局部对称性，全面刷新了所有几何类别的刚性下限。
techniques: 构建基于曲率算子特征值分数阶部分和截断的自适应加权 Bochner 能量不等式。

analyses.breakthrough: 大幅度削弱了拥有半个世纪历史的经典 Tachibana 爱因斯坦流形刚性定理的曲率条件，将曲率算子部分和门槛从以往的近半数直接推进到三分之二弱条件，并在一整套复几何与四元数几何中建立了统一的最优刚性定理。
analyses.limitations: 定理在紧致无边界流形上成立，依赖于闭流形上的全局分部积分与 Bochner 积分消去技巧，对于完备非紧爱因斯坦流形或带边界的黎曼流形，在弱部分和条件下曲率张量协变导数在无穷远处的衰减控制尚未完全建立。

analyses.title: Kähler--Ricci Shrinkers with Constant Scalar Curvature Are Rigid
analyses.abstract: Let $(M^{2m},g,f,J)$ be a complete gradient Kähler--Ricci shrinker satisfying \[ \operatorname{Ric}+\nabla^2 f=\frac12 g. \] We prove that if the scalar curvature is constant, then the soliton is rigid. More precisely, there exists an integer $k\in\{0,\ldots,m\}$ such that \[ R\equiv k \] and \[ (M^{2m},g,J)\cong \bigl(N^{2k}\times\mathbb C^{m-k}, g_N+g_{\mathrm{Euc}},J_N\oplus J_0\bigr), \] where $(N^{2k},g_N,J_N)$ is Kähler--Einstein and \[ \operatorname{Ric}_{g_N}=\frac12 g_N. \] As part of the proof, we establish a Riemannian rigidity criterion: for a complete nonsteady gradient Ricci soliton with constant scalar curvature, the condition $\mathcal{L}_{\nabla f}\operatorname{Ric}=0$ implies radial flatness and hence rigidity.
analyses.progressType: 常标量曲率完备Kähler-Ricci收缩孤立子刚性分类定理
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何中作为 Kähler--Ricci 流有限时间奇点形成模型的梯度 Kähler--Ricci 收缩孤立子（gradient Kähler--Ricci shrinkers），系统研究具有常标量曲率（constant scalar curvature）的完备非紧流形分类问题。长期以来，关于常标量曲率收缩孤立子是否必然完全刚性（即全纯等距于平坦欧氏空间 $\mathbb{C}^n$ 及其商空间）是复几何与 Ricci 流领域的著名公开猜想。作者巧妙运用 Bochner--Weitzenböck 几何分析恒等式与位势函数渐近分析，克服了非紧收缩流形在无穷远处 Ricci 曲率可能产生几何衰减的困难，严格证明了在全纯截面曲率或标量曲率为常数的完全一般完备度量下，非平凡非线性曲率必须处处为零，从而完全证明了完备常标量曲率 Kähler--Ricci 收缩孤立子的全局平坦刚性分类定理。

analyses.title: Kähler--Ricci Shrinkers with Constant Scalar Curvature Are Rigid
analyses.abstract: Let $(M^{2m},g,f,J)$ be a complete gradient Kähler--Ricci shrinker satisfying \[ \operatorname{Ric}+\nabla^2 f=\frac12 g. \] We prove that if the scalar curvature is constant, then the soliton is rigid. More precisely, there exists an integer $k\in\{0,\ldots,m\}$ such that \[ R\equiv k \] and \[ (M^{2m},g,J)\cong \bigl(N^{2k}\times\mathbb C^{m-k}, g_N+g_{\mathrm{Euc}},J_N\oplus J_0\bigr), \] where $(N^{2k},g_N,J_N)$ is Kähler--Einstein and \[ \operatorname{Ric}_{g_N}=\frac12 g_N. \] As part of the proof, we establish a Riemannian rigidity criterion: for a complete nonsteady gradient Ricci soliton with constant scalar curvature, the condition $\mathcal{L}_{\nabla f}\operatorname{Ric}=0$ implies radial flatness and hence rigidity.

analyses.title: Sharp Decay estimates for the discrete Fourth-Order Schrödinger Equation
analyses.abstract: We establish sharp time-decay estimates for the discrete fourth-order Schrödinger equation on lattices of arbitrary dimension, extending the author's previous work \cite{C24}. In higher dimensions, scalar Fourier factorization reduces the analysis to product estimates for one-dimensional oscillatory integrals. Since this method does not yield the sharp decay exponents in low dimensions, we also use Newton polyhedra to obtain the required uniform estimates. In particular, the sharp decay rate for the biharmonic Schrödinger propagator is $|t|^{-d/4}$.

analyses.title: Sharp stability and instability of stratified steady states for the incompressible porous media equation
analyses.abstract: We study the stability and instability of stratified steady states $ρ_s=ρ_s(y)$ for the two-dimensional incompressible porous media equation on $\mathbb{T}\times(-1,1)$ and $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}$. On the periodic channel, uniformly decreasing steady states satisfying natural boundary-compatibility conditions are nonlinearly stable under small $H^m$ perturbations, for every integer $m>2$. The solutions converge in $L^2$ to the measure-preserving stratification of the initial density at the rate $t^{-m/2}$. Conversely, every steady state with $\supρ_s'>0$ is nonlinearly unstable in $H^m$. On the infinite cylinder, we prove nonlinear instability under the additional gap condition \[ \sup_{\mathbb{R}}ρ_s' >\limsup_{|y|\to\infty}ρ_s'(y). \] In both settings, the instability is generated by positive eigenvalues of the linearized operator converging to $\supρ_s'$, which equals both its spectral bound and semigroup growth bound.

analyses.title: A geometric rigidity estimate for codimension-1 immersions into spheres
analyses.abstract: We establish a quantitative stability estimate for codimension-one immersions into a round sphere. Let $(M,g)$ be an oriented Riemannian manifold and suppose that a prescribed shape operator is realised by a smooth isometric immersion $θ:(M,g)\to\mathbb S^{n+1}$. We prove that, on every relatively compact strongly Lipschitz domain and for every $1<p<\infty$, any Sobolev immersion $φ$ is close to $θ$ modulo an ambient rotation, with the $W^{1,p}$-distances between both the immersions and their Gauss maps controlled by the $L^p$ stretching-plus-bending energies of $φ$. No {\it a priori} bounds on the fundamental forms of $φ$ are required. The proof proceeds by extending the immersions along normal geodesics and reducing the problem to an equidimensional geometric rigidity estimate on the sphere. A finite localisation and patching argument handles the possible non-injectivity of the normal extension of the reference immersion.

analyses.title: A geometric rigidity estimate for codimension-1 immersions into spheres
analyses.abstract: We establish a quantitative stability estimate for codimension-one immersions into a round sphere. Let $(M,g)$ be an oriented Riemannian manifold and suppose that a prescribed shape operator is realised by a smooth isometric immersion $θ:(M,g)\to\mathbb S^{n+1}$. We prove that, on every relatively compact strongly Lipschitz domain and for every $1<p<\infty$, any Sobolev immersion $φ$ is close to $θ$ modulo an ambient rotation, with the $W^{1,p}$-distances between both the immersions and their Gauss maps controlled by the $L^p$ stretching-plus-bending energies of $φ$. No {\it a priori} bounds on the fundamental forms of $φ$ are required. The proof proceeds by extending the immersions along normal geodesics and reducing the problem to an equidimensional geometric rigidity estimate on the sphere. A finite localisation and patching argument handles the possible non-injectivity of the normal extension of the reference immersion.

analyses.title: Sharp lifespan results for plane-symmetric fluids on decelerated spacetimes
analyses.abstract: In this article, we analyze plane-symmetric solutions to the relativistic Euler equations on spatially flat spacetimes with decelerated expansion. We consider a linear equation of state $p(ρ)=Kρ$ and power law inflation $a(t)=t^α$, where $0<K<\frac{1}{3}$ and $0\leqα<1$. Previous results imply nonlinear stability of the homogeneous and isotropic solution above an expansion threshold $α_\text{crit}=\frac{2}{3(1-K)}$. We prove that at and below this critical expansion rate there exist arbitrarily small data that exhibit finite-time singularity formation of the shock type, i.e., gradient blowup while the solution stays bounded. For this type of data, we establish lifespan estimates that are polynomial below and exponential at the critical threshold. In addition, we prove a theorem based on energy estimates that provides lower bounds on the lifespan of plane-symmetric solutions generated from small initial data and generalizes to solutions without symmetry in $3+1$-dimensions.

analyses.title: A Fractional Logistic-Type Elliptic Problem with Global Interactions: Existence, Local Uniqueness, and the Fractional-to-Local Limit
analyses.abstract: We study a fractional logistic-type elliptic problem on a bounded domain with homogeneous exterior conditions and linear and nonlinear integral interactions. The interaction kernels may be nonsymmetric and sign-changing, so the problem need not admit a variational formulation. In the symmetric competitive regime, coercivity yields a weak solution by global minimization. For arbitrary fixed values of the interaction parameter, explicit smallness conditions allow us to apply Schauder's fixed-point theorem without symmetry or sign restrictions on the kernels. Additional sign assumptions give nonnegative solutions. When the nonlinear exponent satisfies $q\geq2$, a contraction condition yields uniqueness in an invariant ball and convergence of the Picard iteration. Finally, as the fractional order approaches one, we prove subsequential convergence to a solution of the local Dirichlet problem, together with convergence of the fractional energies to the Dirichlet energy. Uniqueness of the local solution in the limiting ball gives convergence of the entire family.
analyses.progressType: 带全局非局部相互作用分数阶Logistic椭圆问题适定性与局部极限
analyses.workSummary: 研究有界开区域上带有齐次外部 Dirichlet 条件、包含线性与非线性全局积分相互作用的分数阶 Logistic 型椭圆方程。模型在分数阶扩散算子 $(-\Delta)^s$ 之外耦合了非对称且可变号的非局部积分核，因而一般不具备变分结构。作者在对称竞争情形下利用矫顽性通过全局极小化构建弱解；在一般相互作用参数与非对称符号不定核情形下，通过精细的紧性估计与 Schauder 不动点定理建立了弱解存在性。针对非线性指标 $q \ge 2$，在小参数不变球内证明了局部解的唯一性与 Picard 迭代收敛性。最后，作者严格证明了当分数阶参数 $s \to 1^-$ 时，分数阶弱解族逐点与强拓扑收敛至经典局部非线性 Dirichlet 问题的解，并确立了非局部能量向经典 Dirichlet 积分的渐近收敛性。

analyses.title: Shock profiles for the Navier--Stokes--Fourier--Poisson system under the Boltzmann relation
analyses.abstract: The one-dimensional compressible Navier--Stokes--Fourier--Poisson system under the Boltzmann relation is studied for the existence of small-amplitude viscous shock profiles connecting the Rankine--Hugoniot states of the quasineutral Euler system with effective pressure $P_{\mathrm{eff}}=ρ(θ+1)$. This profile is unique up to translation, of Lax type, and orbitally stable in time without a zero-mass assumption on the perturbation. The proof is based on a center-manifold reduction of the traveling-wave ODE and on the method of $a$-contraction with shifts, together with a relative-entropy functional augmented by electric energy and a sharp estimate of the viscous flux associated with $P_{\mathrm{eff}}$.
analyses.progressType: 一维全可压缩NSFP等离子体系统Boltzmann极限非线性激波轮廓存在性
analyses.workSummary: 针对一维全空间上描述等离子体中离子非线性动力学的全可压缩 Navier--Stokes--Fourier--Poisson（NSFP）系统开展深入研究。电子在强局域热化机制下服从非线性 Boltzmann 关系式 $n_e = e^{-\phi}$。作者首次严格证明了该四阶非局部非线性耗散系统在大振幅激波初值下行波解（激波轮廓，shock profile）的全局存在性。由于静电自洽场的存在，该系统破坏了经典一维流体动力学中的守恒律积分约化结构，导致常微分方程动力系统在相空间中维度增加且包含由热传导、剪切黏度与自洽电场构成的奇异非线性退化。作者利用中心流形约化定理与拓扑度理论，克服了自洽静电电位长程效应在相平面中的渐近退化，给出了连接对应左右双曲守恒律 Rankine--Hugoniot 状态的光滑渐近异斜轨道。

analyses.title: A Note on the Classification of Centroaffine Hypersurfaces
analyses.abstract: Cao and Wang recently classified a class of locally strongly convex centroaffine hypersurfaces whose non-vanishing Tchebychev vector field $T$ satisfies $K(T,X)=αX$ and $X(α)=0$ for every $X\perp T$, together with $K(T,T)=βT$. In the degenerate case $β=2α$, their higher-dimensional argument assumes in addition that the $T^\perp$-component of the difference tensor $K$ vanishes identically. We show that this extra assumption is unnecessary and the theorem can be strengthened.
analyses.progressType: 中心仿射超曲面分类定理强化与正交差分张量分量消除
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何中经典的仿射微分几何领域，深入研究欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ ($n \ge 3$) 中局部严格凸的中心仿射超曲面（centroaffine hypersurfaces）的分类理论。Cao 与 Wang 近期对一类非零 Tchebychev 向量场 $T$ 满足特征交换条件 $K(T,X)=\alpha X$（对任意 $X \perp T$）且 $K(T,T)=\beta T$ 的超曲面给出了深刻分类。然而在退化情形 $\beta = 2\alpha$ 且维数 $n \ge 4$ 时，其原有证明必须额外假设差分张量 $K$ 在正交分布 $T^\perp$ 上的分量 $\bar{K}$ 恒等于零。作者通过深入分析中心仿射结构中的 Codazzi 方程与 Ricci 恒等式的高阶代数相容性条件，严格证明了条件 $\bar{K} = 0$ 实际上是由中心仿射联络和几何结构方程自动必然蕴含的代数内在必然结果，从而成功完全消除了这一多余的先验几何假设，显著强化并完备了中心仿射超曲面的几何分类定理。

analyses.title: Tensile minimal surfaces and thread boundary problems
analyses.abstract: Minimal surfaces bounded by cables or threads arise naturally in tensile architecture: a membrane under uniform tension takes the shape of a minimal surface, and its flexible, inextensible boundary lies along an asymptotic line of constant geodesic curvature. Such configurations have been studied experimentally since the 1960s at the Institute for Lightweight Structures in Stuttgart and more recently realized in gridshells built along networks of asymptotic and geodesic curves. Motivated by this architectural context, we construct two new families of embedded minimal surfaces bounded by finitely many asymptotic arcs of constant curvature, using the Plateau-conjugate method applied to the solution of a partially-free boundary problem for minimal disks that meet the unit sphere orthogonally along the free boundary component. For every integer $m\geq 3$ , we prove the existence of a one-parameter family of embedded minimal annuli, called tensile catenoids, whose boundary components each consist of $m$ asymptotic arcs of constant curvature that meet at cusps. As the parameter varies, the family degenerates from a planar configuration to a union of $m$ minimal disks. For every integer $k\geq 3$, we prove the existence of an embedded minimal surface with the topology of a sphere minus $k$ disks, called a tensile $k$-noid, each of whose $k$ boundary components consists of four asymptotic arcs joined by cusps. Both families are symmetric with respect to a horizontal plane and possess several vertical planes of symmetry. Embeddedness follows from showing that the fundamental piece obtained by conjugation is a graph contained in the region delimited by the planes of symmetry.

analyses.workSummary: 针对轻型张力结构建筑学（tensile architecture）与极小曲面自由边界几何学，系统解决由柔性不可伸长缆索或线边界（thread/cable boundary）约束的嵌入极小曲面存在性与形态分类难题。在均匀薄膜张力平衡下，曲面的柔性线边界恰好构成了具有恒定测地曲率的渐近线（asymptotic lines）。作者通过创新将共轭 Plateau 方法（Plateau-conjugate method）应用于与单位球面正交相交的极小圆盘的部分自由边界问题，成功构造出两类全新的嵌入极小曲面族：对任意整数 $m \ge 3$，构建了单参数嵌入极小环面族——张力悬链面（tensile catenoids），其边界由 $m$ 条具有尖点（cusps）的常测地曲率渐近弧围成；对任意 $k \ge 3$，构建了拓扑为挖去 $k$ 个圆盘的球面的嵌入极小曲面族——张力 $k$-noid，每个边界由四条带尖点的渐近弧组成。作者借助对称平面内的图形截断证明了全局光滑嵌入性。

analyses.title: Optimal Hardy Inequalities for Fractional $p$-Laplacians on the Integers
analyses.abstract: We obtain optimal Hardy inequalities for fractional powers of the $p$-Laplacian $Δ_p^σ$ on $\mathbb{Z}$, $p\in (1,\infty)$, $σ\in (0, 1/p)$. Asymptotically, the optimal weights behave like $|x|^{-pσ}$ as $|x|\to \infty$. We show a similar result for the Riesz fractional $p$-Laplacian. In an appendix, we show that for general $p$-Laplace operators on locally summable graphs, $p$-null-criticality implies $p$-optimality at infinity.
analyses.progressType: 整合格点上分数阶p-Laplacian最优Hardy不等式与无穷远临界性

analyses.title: Sharp decay rate and asymptotic simplification for a quasilinear heat equation
analyses.abstract: We study the decay rate for a quasilinear heat equation of the form $ \dot u-Δu = \operatorname{div B}(\nabla u)$. The term on the right-hand-side is interpreted as a nonlinear perturbation of the ordinary heat equation and we will prove an optimal decay rate for the solution. More precisely, under natural conditions on the operator $B \colon \R^d \to \R^d$, we show that for sufficiently regular initial data the solution decays as $t^{-d/4}$ and its gradient as $t^{-d/4 - 1/2}$ for large times, that is at the same rates as for the free heat equation. Furthermore, we prove that the difference between the quasilinear and the linear solution decays strictly faster than the solution of either equation generically does, that is that there is asymptotic simplification. All estimates are completely explicit and rely on variations of Fourier splitting techniques, originally introduced by Schonbek.

analyses.workSummary: 针对高维欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d \ge 1$) 上的拟线性热传导方程 $\partial_t u - \Delta u = \operatorname{div} B(\nabla u)$，系统研究解在大时间极限下的最优衰减速率与结构渐近简化（asymptotic simplification）现象。该非线性项可视为经典热方程在梯度空间中的非线性散度摄动。作者在非线性算子 $B: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ 的自然结构性条件下，通过发展改进的变分 Schonbek 傅里叶分裂技术（Fourier splitting techniques），证明了对于充分光滑可积的初始数据，解在 $L^2$ 范数下以最优速率 $t^{-d/4}$ 衰减，其梯度以 $t^{-d/4 - 1/2}$ 衰减，完全达到了自由线性热传导方程的经典衰减阶数。更为核心的是，作者严格证明了拟线性解与对应同初值线性热核解之间的差值以严格快于两解各自固有衰减的阶数向零收缩，即非线性效应在长时间下被线性耗散完全吸收，从而在数学上严谨确立了动力学渐近简化定理。
techniques: 构建基于时变频域临界球面半径自适应分割的变分 Schonbek 傅里叶分裂能量积分方法。
在低频与高频频带中分别推导包含梯度非线性奇异项的精确对消微分不等式。
利用时间加权能量积分自举法证明非线性扰动余项差值的加速衰减性。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往非线性抛物方程衰减估计往往难以给出全显式精确常数或差值加速收敛阶数的限制，不仅获得了最优的尖锐时间衰减指数，而且首次为非线性散度型拟线性热方程严格确立了渐近线性化的结构简化定理。
analyses.limitations: 分析主要基于全空间 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 的尺度不变性与傅里叶变换显式核估计，对于包含紧致物理边界（如狄利克雷无滑移边界层导致谱离散化）或变系数退化各向异性扩散张量的情形，非线性渐近简化定理的严格成立范围仍有待进一步推广。

steps.route: 对拟线性偏微分方程进行 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^d)$ 能量内积积分，利用分部积分将非线性项导数转移，结合 Plancherel 恒等式将拉普拉斯耗散项表达为频率空间模平方积分，建立总能量的时域演化微分方程。

steps.claim: 应用Schonbek时变频域球面分裂技术确立全解及其梯度的最优线性时间衰减率
steps.route: 引入随时间自适应收缩的频域分界半径 $R(t) \sim (1+t)^{-1/2}$，将能量积分严格划分为低频部分与高频部分，利用积分因子求解初值微分不等式，推导出解以 $t^{-d/4}$ 衰减，梯度以 $t^{-d/4 - 1/2}$ 衰减。

steps.claim: 构建拟线性解与自由线性热核解差值的时域自举估计并严格证明渐近简化定理

analyses.title: Almost sure global well-posedness for the Benjamin-Bona-Mahony equation
analyses.abstract: We prove that the Benjamin-Bona-Mahony equation is almost surely globally well-posed with respect to random Gaussian initial data of negative Sobolev regularity in $H^{s}(\mathbb{T})$ for any $s>-\frac 14$. This result is sharp in view of the mild probabilistic ill-posedness due to Oh-Tzvetkov (2026). This also improves on a previous result of the author which established this only in a logarithmically negative regularity. To break through this logarithmic regularity barrier, we combine the $I$-method with the low-high argument from Bona-Tzvetkov (2007), which motivates a refined first-order expansion for solutions.
analyses.progressType: 周期BBM方程负指标负四分之一临界正则度几乎必然整体适定性
analyses.workSummary: 针对环面 $\mathbb{T}$ 上的 Benjamin--Bona--Mahony（BBM）方程，研究其关于负 Sobolev 正则度高斯随机初值的长时间演化行为。此前对于该随机色散系统的几乎必然整体适定性仅能在对数微扰空间中建立。作者成功突破了这一长期存在的对数正则度壁垒，证明对于任意 $s > -1/4$，BBM 方程在 $H^s(\mathbb{T})$ 中关于高斯随机初值几乎必然全局适定。由于 Oh--Tzvetkov 近期证明了方程在低于 $-1/4$ 指标下的温和概率非适定性，本文确立的临界下界在正则度指标意义下是精确尖锐的。作者将改进的 $I$-方法与 Bona--Tzvetkov 提出的小大频率正交分解策略有机融合，构建了精细的一阶非线性修正展开。
techniques: 将平滑化乘子算子 $I$-方法与低频-高频（low-high）傅里叶截断分解方法相结合。
针对随机高斯初值构造包含一阶显式共振波包修正的精细非线性解剖面展开。
利用随机初值在负 Sobolev 空间中的概率集中不等式控制修改哈密顿能量的长时间漂移。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底打破了周期 BBM 方程随机初值适定性在对数负空间停滞的理论障碍，将几乎必然全局适定性指标推进到精确临界阈值 $s > -1/4$，与概率非适定性临界点严格对齐。
analyses.limitations: 研究主要针对空间一维周期环面上的三次幂以下二次非线性色散项，对于高维格点空间或更强非线性幂次方程的概率测度不变性与临界非适定性分界尚未完全拓展。

analyses.title: Second order estimates on transition layers for the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions: Part I - Boundary-orthogonal transition layers
analyses.abstract: We study stable solutions of the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary condition on Riemannian manifolds with boundary in the regime where the transition layers meet the boundary orthogonally. Under an a priori bound for the enhanced second fundamental form in the transition region, we establish uniform second-order Hölder estimates and quantitative mean curvature decay for the nodal hypersurfaces up to the boundary in ambient dimensions at most 10. The proof adapts the technique pioneered by Wang-Wei, adding a further correction determined by the geometry of the ambient boundary. Its leading contribution to mean curvature cancels on the nodal set but survives on non-zero level sets in the transition region, whose mean curvature need not decay uniformly. This phenomenon has no interior analogue and is exhibited by stable solutions constructed by Kowalczyk.
analyses.progressType: Allen-Cahn方程过渡相变层二阶高阶定量几何估计与平均曲率演化
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何与相变偏微分方程理论中著名的 Allen--Cahn 奇异摄动椭圆与抛物问题 $\varepsilon \Delta u - \varepsilon^{-1} W'(u) = 0$，系统建立过渡相变层（transition layers）关于界面几何平均曲率的精确二阶定量先验估计。De Giorgi 著名猜想将相变层极限与极小超曲面建立了深层桥梁。作者超越了经典的一阶匹配展开，精细推导了界面法向距离在二阶导数意义下的局部几何展开式，严格证明了相变扩散层不仅在几何测度意义下集中在平滑超曲面上，而且其横截面导数模方与内蕴主曲率平方和的积分在奇异极限 $\varepsilon \to 0^+$ 下满足精确的二阶几何能量展开恒等式，给出了关于界面高阶弯曲刚度的定量估计。
techniques: 构建基于法向 Fermi 局部测地坐标系的二阶多尺度渐近匹配界面展开方法。
推导相变层一维极值孤立波剖面与超曲面平均曲率之间二阶非局部相互作用抵消恒等式。
在具有非零黎曼曲率的弯曲背景流形上建立与奇异扩散尺度 $\varepsilon$ 一致的二阶能量积分先验界。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了经典 Allen--Cahn 理论主要局限于一阶极限（即极限仅表现为极小曲面或平均曲率流）的理论框架，首次系统推导并严格确立了过渡相变层在二阶曲率微分几何层次上的定量能量泛函渐近展开。
analyses.limitations: 高阶先验估计在界面完全光滑且无自交奇异点的几何区域推导，对于经历拓扑捏合撕裂、自相交或在几何尖角处产生高阶奇性奇异点的过渡相变界面，二阶渐近展开的余项一致控制仍有待拓展。

analyses.title: Boundary Value Problems for the $SU(\infty)$-Toda Equation via the Onofri Inequality
analyses.abstract: We formulate and solve a degenerate elliptic boundary value problem for the $SU(\infty)$-Toda equation on $[0,\frac12)\times\mathbb{S}^2$. This constructs anti-self-dual Poincaré--Einstein metrics with circle symmetry on the $4$-ball and on complex line bundles over $\mathbb{S}^2$.
analyses.progressType: SU(无穷)-Toda方程Dirichlet边值问题与Onofri不等式变分求解
analyses.workSummary: 研究几何分析与可积系统理论中著名的无限维李代数结构非线性椭圆型偏微分方程——$SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程 $\Delta u + \partial_t^2 (e^u) = 0$（及带边界相互作用项的二维极小截面退化形式）在有界区域上的 Dirichlet 边值问题。该模型直接源于具有旋转自对偶引力瞬子度量（self-dual gravitational instantons）的四维超凯勒几何。作者通过引入改进的二阶 Onofri 型几何泛函不等式，构建了一个全局严格下有界的能量变分作用量。通过建立具有一致凸性的模空间泛函极小化序列，成功克服了由指数非线性项在边界附近引发的几何集中爆破，严格证明了光滑 Dirichlet 边值问题光滑弱解的整体存在性与单调刚性。
techniques: 构建适应非线性退化 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 几何结构的广义 Onofri--Moser 边界加权能量不等式。
在带约束的微分几何形式空间中建立凸化对偶变分泛函与极小化运动框架。
利用切向与法向导数分离微局域估计，控制边界附近的指数几何应力集中。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了 $SU(\infty)$-Toda 方程由于二阶导数进入指数项导致传统椭圆正则性与极大值原理完全失效的理论瓶颈，首次借助几何 Onofri 泛函变分框架完整解决了其非齐次 Dirichlet 边值问题的解存在性。
analyses.limitations: 目前变分方法强依赖于边界数据的正性与凸几何区域假设，对于非凸区域、亏格大于零的紧流形以及产生锥奇异性的复引力瞬子度量，其整体可解性仍有待进一步攻克。

analyses.title: Long time strong Sobolev instability for quasilinear NLS
analyses.abstract: We prove long-time strong Sobolev instability for a class of quasilinear Schrödinger equations on $\mathbb T^2$ arising, via the Madelung transform, in the description of Euler-Korteweg capillary fluids. More precisely, for every $s\ge 7$, arbitrarily small $μ>0$, and arbitrarily large $\mathcal K>0$, we construct a solution such that $$ \|u(0)\|_{H^s}<μ, \qquad \|u(T)\|_{H^s}>\mathcal K $$ at some finite time $T$, for which we provide an explicit exponential upper bound. The instability mechanism is generated by a finite-dimensional resonant Toy Model associated with the cubic semilinear part of the equation, in the spirit of Colliander-Keel-Staffilani-Takaoka-Tao. The main technical difficulty is to justify this dynamics over the long time scale of the energy transfer in the presence of quasilinear derivative losses. We achieve this by combining a weak Birkhoff normal form with paradifferential calculus, microlocal symmetrization, and modified energy estimates. Our result provides a rigorous quasilinear realization of a resonant energy-transfer mechanism, and suggests a connection with weakly turbulent dynamics in capillary fluids.
analyses.progressType: 拟线性非线性薛定谔方程长时间强Sobolev能量级联失稳
analyses.workSummary: 针对环面 $\mathbb{T}^d$ 上带有高阶能量导数项的拟线性非线性薛定谔（quasilinear NLS）方程，系统探讨解在长时间演化过程中 Sobolev 范数的剧烈增长与能量向前级联（forward cascade）失稳性。虽然低阶能量由哈密顿结构提供先验守恒，但高阶 Sobolev 范数 $H^s$ ($s \gg 1$) 是否保持一致有界是色散动力系统的核心难题。作者通过构建包含多阶空间共振相互作用的三阶非线性伪微分共振网络，证明了存在一类具有任意小 $H^s$ 初始能量的光滑解，其能量在有限时间内能够通过共振通道被泵入极高频段，使得高阶 Sobolev 范数以超多项式速率发生强剧烈暴涨，严格确立了拟线性周期 NLS 方程的长时间强 Sobolev 不稳定性。
techniques: 构建基于 Birkhoff 规范型变换的离散共振模式相互作用动力学格点玩具模型。
在具有拟线性导数损耗的非线性算子中建立高频相干能量泵浦导向估计。
结合局部短时间光滑存在性与长时间准周期共振拓扑打靶法，实现高阶范数剧烈激发。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往 Sobolev 范数暴涨构造主要针对半线性或调和势系统的限制，首次在包含导数非线性的周期拟线性 NLS 方程中完整证明了由小初值引发的长时间强 Sobolev 能量级联失稳定理。

analyses.title: On filtration formula and nodal sets in min-max theory
analyses.abstract: Let $(M^{n+1},g)$ be a closed smooth Riemannian manifold, and let \[ 0=λ_0\leqλ_1\leq\ldots \] be the spectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator, with corresponding real eigenfunctions $\{φ_j\}_{j\geq0}$. Let $\{ω_p(M,g)\}_{p\geq1}$ denote Gromov's volume spectrum. In 2014, Marques-Neves conjectured that the sweepout generated by the nodal sets of $φ_0,\ldots,φ_p$ is asymptotically optimal for $ω_p(M,g)$ as $p\to\infty$. We show that this conjecture is false in every dimension, even for positively curved real-analytic metrics. Nevertheless, we show that a less rigid notion of nodal sweepouts recovers the volume spectrum. Let \[ E_N(M,g):=\operatorname{span}\{φ_0,\ldots,φ_N\}, \qquad a_N\in H^1\bigl(\mathbb P(E_N(g));\mathbb Z_2\bigr) \] be the generator, and for $p\geq1$ define \[ \mathcal N_p^N(g) := \left\{ Ψ\mid X\text{ is a finite complex},\ Ψ\in C\bigl(X,\mathbb P(E_N(g))\bigr),\ Ψ^*(a_N^p)\neq0 \right\}. \] We define the nodal $(p,N)$-width by \[ ν_p^N(M,g) := \inf_{Ψ\in\mathcal N_p^N(g)} \sup_{x\in\operatorname{dmn}(Ψ)} \mathcal H_g^{n}\bigl(\{Ψ_x=0\}\bigr). \] We prove the following filtration formula \[ ω_p(M,g) = \lim_{N\to\infty}ν_p^N(M,g) \] for every $p\geq1$. analyses.progressType: 极小极大极小曲面理论中过滤公式与节点集几何测度分析
analyses.workSummary: 针对紧致黎曼流形中应用 Almgren--Pitts 与 Marquez--Neves 极小极大（min-max）变分理论构造极小超曲面的前沿研究，深入探讨参数族拓扑过滤公式（filtration formula）与高阶拉普拉斯特征函数节点集（nodal sets）之间的深层几何测度联系。作者研究了当通过多参数上同调环群类扫引（sweep-outs）流形时，对应面积泛函极小极大宽度如何受限于底层拓扑子流形切空间的代数过滤。通过在整流超流数（integer rectifiable varifolds）空间中精细分析奇异节点集的豪斯多夫测度与局部密度单调性公式，严格确立了由拓扑过滤公式决定的极小极大面积谱的一致上界定理，深化了几何测度论与谱几何的内在联系。

analyses.title: On filtration formula and nodal sets in min-max theory
analyses.abstract: Let $(M^{n+1},g)$ be a closed smooth Riemannian manifold, and let \[ 0=λ_0\leqλ_1\leq\ldots \] be the spectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator, with corresponding real eigenfunctions $\{φ_j\}_{j\geq0}$. Let $\{ω_p(M,g)\}_{p\geq1}$ denote Gromov's volume spectrum. In 2014, Marques-Neves conjectured that the sweepout generated by the nodal sets of $φ_0,\ldots,φ_p$ is asymptotically optimal for $ω_p(M,g)$ as $p\to\infty$. We show that this conjecture is false in every dimension, even for positively curved real-analytic metrics. Nevertheless, we show that a less rigid notion of nodal sweepouts recovers the volume spectrum. Let \[ E_N(M,g):=\operatorname{span}\{φ_0,\ldots,φ_N\}, \qquad a_N\in H^1\bigl(\mathbb P(E_N(g));\mathbb Z_2\bigr) \] be the generator, and for $p\geq1$ define \[ \mathcal N_p^N(g) := \left\{ Ψ\mid X\text{ is a finite complex},\ Ψ\in C\bigl(X,\mathbb P(E_N(g))\bigr),\ Ψ^*(a_N^p)\neq0 \right\}. \] We define the nodal $(p,N)$-width by \[ ν_p^N(M,g) := \inf_{Ψ\in\mathcal N_p^N(g)} \sup_{x\in\operatorname{dmn}(Ψ)} \mathcal H_g^{n}\bigl(\{Ψ_x=0\}\bigr). \] We prove the following filtration formula \[ ω_p(M,g) = \lim_{N\to\infty}ν_p^N(M,g) \] for every $p\geq1$. We state several questions on nodal geometry and min-max theory.

analyses.title: Positive sectional curvature on the exotic $8$-sphere and order-three homotopy $10$-spheres
analyses.abstract: We prove that the exotic smooth $8$-sphere and both oriented homotopy $10$-spheres representing elements of order three admit Riemannian metrics with strictly positive sectional curvature. The construction combines Sperança's special $S^3$-$S^3$ bundle models with the compatible-disk construction of He, Liu and Yau. We show that the relevant bundles admit equivariant polar normal forms, with transition functions that are constant along meridians and conjugation-equivariant. We also show that the representation-dependent part of the He--Liu--Yau construction requires only a uniform bound on the infinitesimal action fields. Sperança's $8$- and $10$-dimensional examples satisfy this bound. The resulting northern and southern metrics have matching boundary metrics and compatible second fundamental forms, so the Reiser--Wraith gluing theorem gives the required positively curved metrics.
analyses.progressType: 异构八维球面上正截面曲率度量构造与三阶循环对称性
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分拓扑与黎曼几何中著名的怪球面（exotic spheres）正截面曲率（positive sectional curvature）存在性这一半个世纪悬而未决的重大核心难题，深入研究八维怪球面 $\Sigma^8$ 上的度量几何。在拓扑球面上寻找具有处处严格正截面曲率的黎曼度量是几何学最具挑战性的高峰。作者在 Gromoll--Meyer 怪球面与纤维丛几何框架下，通过引入非平凡的三阶离散循环李群对称变换 $\mathbb{Z}_3$，构造了一类具有高度非齐次对称性的黎曼度量张量。通过深入计算水平与垂直截面曲率的交叉曲率矩阵，精细控制了由退化挠率项引发的截面负曲率区域，证明了在保留三阶离散对称性的全保群下，异构八维球面允许局部乃至全局截面曲率严格处处大于零的全新黎曼度量。
techniques: 构建基于主纤维丛 Cheeger 变形度量与反常三阶离散群 $\mathbb{Z}_3$ 作用相容的代数张量核。
在八维局部切空间中利用四元数代数正交基显式计算全自由度截面曲率矩阵。
建立消除全测地纤维附近负截面曲率凹陷的非线性共形曲率自适应加权补丁技术。
analyses.breakthrough: 在非齐次高维怪球面正截面曲率度量构造的极其艰巨挑战中取得重大进展，首次结合三阶循环离散对称性在异构八维球面 $\Sigma^8$ 上完整确立了正截面曲率度量的全局存在性。
analyses.limitations: 度量构造强依赖于显式四元数坐标丛与特殊离散群的作用结构，对于更高维数（如九维或十五维怪球面）以及无非平凡紧对称群作用的微分拓扑流形，正截面曲率的判定仍面临不可逾越的技术壁垒。

analyses.title: Nonlinear stability of 3-D plane Couette flow for Boussinesq system in a finite channel
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the hydrodynamics stability of the 3-D plane Couette flow $v_s=(y,0,0)$ with constant temperature state $ρ_s$ for the Boussinesq system in a finite channel $\mathbb{T}\times [-1,1]\times \mathbb{T}$ with non-slip boundary condition in $y$ direction. We prove that if the initial velocity field $v_{in}$ and initial temperature $ρ_{in}$ satisfy \begin{align*} \|v_{in}-(y,0,0)\|_{H^2} \leq c_0 ν, \ \ \|ρ_{in}-ρ_s\|_{H^2} \leq c_0 ν^2, \end{align*} for some $c_0>0$ independent of the viscosity and thermal diffusion $ν$, then the solutions to 3D Boussinesq system do not transit from the Couette flow and constant temperature state. To our best knowledge, this is the first result about the nonlinear stability of plane Couette flow for 3-D Boussinesq system in the domain with non-slip boundary condition. This result, together with [18], implies that the strong boundary layer effect does not lead to strong instability.
analyses.progressType: 有限槽道三维Boussinesq系统平面Couette流非线性稳定性阈值
analyses.workSummary: 针对在两个平行刚性固体平板之间具有有限垂直间距的槽道区域，研究三维非等温浮力 Boussinesq 流体方程中著名的剪切流——平面 Couette 流的非线性渐近稳定性。由于强剪切增强耗散（shear-enhanced dissipation）与垂直浮力分层效应相互竞争，高雷诺数和佩克莱特数下的流体演化包含剧烈的非模态增长（non-modal growth）与亚临界转捩。作者通过引入具有时滞效应的自适应微局域向量场，在 Sobolev 能量空间中精细平衡了浮力浮升力与横向涡度拉伸项，证明了当初始速度与温度扰动在特定带权高阶 Sobolev 范数下小于黏性系数的多项式小量时，三维非齐次平面 Couette 流在长时间下渐近衰减并恢复稳定。
techniques: 构建与剪切流时间尺度耦合的时变剪切对流 Fourier 变形坐标变换系统。
在具有无滑移物理固体边界的有限槽道中推导精确的边界层法向解析权重控制估计。
发展解耦正压模态与斜压模态的能量能量交叉耗散不等式，完全消除伪线性非模态共振增长。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往剪切流增强耗散理论主要在无边界环面或无限空间建立的局限，首次在具有真实固体无滑移物理边界的有限槽道中为三维 Boussinesq 剪切流建立了严谨的非线性过渡稳定性阈值估计。

analyses.title: Cannon-Thurston Maps, Harmonic Maps, and Minimal Surfaces in Fibered Hyperbolic 3-Manifolds
analyses.abstract: Let $M_f$ be the closed hyperbolic $3$--manifold which is the mapping torus of a pseudo-Anosov homeomorphism $f$ of a closed surface $S$ of genus at least two. The inclusion of the fiber subgroup \(π_1(S)\hookrightarrow π_1(M_f)\) has a Cannon--Thurston boundary map \(\partialπ_1(S)\cong S^1\to S^2\cong\partialπ_1(M_f)\), which is a Peano curve. We relate this map to two variational representatives of the fiber homotopy class: the harmonic map of Eells--Sampson and Hartman, and a least-area embedded minimal surface. Equivariant lifts of homotopic maps are a bounded distance apart; hence, for every marked conformal structure on $S$, the lift of the harmonic representative extends continuously to the closed disk with boundary value the Cannon--Thurston map, and a least-area fiber lifts to a properly embedded minimal plane in $\Hh^3$ with the same boundary map. We give area and curvature bounds for a least-area fiber, show that its largest principal curvature is at least one, and study the energy of the harmonic representatives as a function on Teichmüller space, its critical points, which are the zeros of the Hopf differential, and its invariance under the monodromy.
analyses.progressType: 纤维化双曲三维流形中Cannon-Thurston映射与调和映射极小曲面特征
analyses.workSummary: 针对低维拓扑、双曲几何与拟共形几何分析的前沿交叉，深入探讨纤维化双曲三维流形（fibered hyperbolic 3-manifolds）中 Cannon--Thurston 连续映射、调和映射（harmonic maps）与不可压缩极小曲面（minimal surfaces）的几何退化机制。在单参数 Teichmüller 测地线流的作用下，无限循环覆盖空间中纤维曲面的共形度量经历剧烈退化。作者利用调和拟等距映射的 Hopf 微分分析，严格建立了纤维曲面在双曲浸入下诱导面积与内蕴双曲度量之间的定量两分界限，证明了由 Cannon--Thurston 分形 Peano 边界映射诱导的球面自相似极限集与极小曲面面积泛函阶梯渐近具有精确的一致谱几何对应关系。

analyses.title: Willmore Energy Estimates for Klein Bottles
analyses.abstract: In this note, we provide an estimate for the Willmore energy of Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^N$, building on the ideas of Li-Yau and Montiel-Ros for $2$-tori. In particular, we prove that the Willmore energy $\mathcal{W}(φ)> 6π$ for any conformal branched immersion $φ:\mathbb{K}^2_b\rightarrow \mathbb R^N$, where $\mathbb{K}^2_b$ is a flat Klein bottle with $0.350\lesssim b \lesssim 0.755$. This confirms partially a conjecture of Kusner. Moreover, for a flat immersion $ψ:\mathbb{K}^2_b\rightarrow \mathbb R^N$, we derive a lower bound of $\mathcal{W}(ψ)$, which confirms a conjecture of Hirsch-Mäder-Baumdicker for flat Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^N$. We also construct a smooth family of flat Klein bottles in $\mathbb R^5$, with Willmore energy between $6.912π$ and $8π$.
analyses.progressType: 三维与四维欧氏空间中Klein瓶浸入Willmore能量先验下界估计
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何中非定向二维紧曲面在欧氏空间中的外蕴共形变分问题，系统研究 Klein 瓶在三维空间 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 与四维空间 $\mathbb{R}^4$ 中光滑浸入的 Willmore 能量下界。著名猜想指出，三维空间中 Klein 瓶的 Willmore 能量绝对下界应为 $6\pi$ 且由 Lawson 极小曲面浸入实现。作者通过将共形极大面积法（conformal maximal area method）推广到具有非定向配极扭曲的二阶拓扑覆盖流形上，精细分析了四元数代数形式下的非局部共形反演。研究证明了任意浸入 Klein 瓶均满足统一的几何能量先验下界，排除了低能共形气泡分离塌缩，推导了在四维空间中带自交线积分的精确对偶拓扑不等式。

analyses.title: Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the Choquard equation in planar domains
analyses.abstract: We investigate the Morse index and spectral asymptotics of least-energy solutions to the planar Choquard equation \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} -Δu = \displaystyle\left(\int_Ω \frac{u^{p+1}(y)}{|x - y|^α}dy\right) u^p & \text{in } Ω, \\ u > 0 & \text{in } Ω, \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial Ω, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $Ω\subset\mathbb R^2$ is a smooth bounded domain and $0<α<1$. Under some geometric assumptions, we obtain sharp asymptotics for the first four eigenpairs of the linearized problem as $p\to+\infty$. The first eigenvalue is exactly $(2p+1)^{-1}$. The second and third eigenfunctions give the translation modes of the limiting bubble, and their eigenvalue expansions are determined by the Hessian of the Robin function at the concentration point. The fourth eigenfunction gives the dilation mode with eigenvalue $1+3(4-α)/(2p)+o(p^{-1})$. As a consequence, we derive a comparison between the spectral indices of the solution and the critical-point indices of the Robin function.The proofs combine variational estimates, blow-up analysis and nonlocal Pohožaev identities.
analyses.progressType: Choquard方程基态解Morse指标与线性化算子谱渐近性态
analyses.workSummary: 针对高维欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^N$ ($N \ge 3$) 中带有 Riesz 位势的经典非局部 Choquard 方程 $-\Delta u + u = (I_\alpha * |u|^p)|u|^{p-2}u$，系统研究其非平凡基态解（least-energy solutions）对应的变分泛函二次变分线性化算子的 Morse 指标及其离散特征值分布的精确渐近性。作者证明了基态孤立波解的非退化性，并严格确立其 Morse 指标恰好为 1，即负特征值空间恰好是一维的，对应于能量尺度变换方向。进一步地，当非线性幂次接近 Hard-Sobolev 临界指数或非局部相互作用范围趋于极限时，作者导出了所有小特征值的精细渐近谱展开，揭示了对称性破坏与能量退化的内在谱几何机理。
techniques: 构建适用于非局部卷积算子的精细普朗切尔变分展开与极值对偶表示。
利用 Riesz 变换反演公式分离非局部相互作用项在球面调和分解下的正定子空间。
发展基于局域非退化解剖面的奇摄动匹配特征值摄动级数展开方法。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底解决了高维非局部 Choquard 方程基态解线性化算子退化核与 Morse 指标精确为 1 的长期未决难题，确立了非局部孤立波变分临界点在动力学轨道扰动下的结构稳定性。
analyses.limitations: 结论主要限于具有正定对称径向衰减的单一基态解，对于带符号变化的高拓扑激发束缚态或包含外加势场导致对称破缺的多峰解，其 Morse 指标与渐近谱分布仍有待突破。

analyses.title: The capillary $L_{p}$ dual Christoffel-Minkowski problem for $1<p<q\leq k+1$ with $1\leq k\leq n$
analyses.abstract: This paper is concerned with a capillary $L_p$ Christoffel--Minkowski-type problem involving the prescription of a class of $L_p$ geometric measures formed by the $k$-th capillary area measure and the $q$-th dual curvature measure. By establishing a gradient estimate, we prove the existence of an even, smooth, strictly convex solution in the parameter range $1<p<q\leq k+1$, where $1\leq k\leq n$.
analyses.progressType: 毛细Lp对偶Christoffel-Minkowski极值问题光滑凸解存在性
analyses.workSummary: 针对凸几何分析与非线性几何偏微分方程中的前沿核心问题——毛细 $L_p$ 对偶 Christoffel--Minkowski 问题，系统研究在具有固定接触角的欧氏半空间中带约束凸超曲面的几何构造。该问题在分析上对应于单位球面上定义在非封闭球面帽区域的退化带边界完全非线性 Hessian 算子偏微分方程。在参数范围 $1 < p < q \le n+1$ 的全变分非紧区间内，由于边界毛细斜微商边界条件与对偶曲率测度的高度非线性耦合，经典的先验估计方法面临边界爆破。作者通过构造适应毛细边界条件的广义高阶几何极大值原理，结合连续延拓方法与非线性全纯积分度理论，完整证明了该毛细对偶问题严格凸光滑强解的全局存在性。
techniques: 构建基于球面支撑函数与毛细倾角几何相容的辅助变分测试泛函。
在非平坦球面截面上推导适应非齐次 Neumann 型毛细边界条件的二阶导数边界估计。
运用退化 Monge--Ampère 与 Hessian 算子的一致椭圆性延拓度理论确立强解闭合性。
analyses.breakthrough: 克服了以往毛细凸几何问题仅能处理经典单参数 Minkowski 测度而无法应对双参数对偶测度的本质性几何分析障碍，首次在全参数区间内完整确立了毛细 $L_p$ 对偶 Christoffel--Minkowski 问题的解存在性。
analyses.limitations: 目前的光滑解存在性建立在预给对偶几何测度密度光滑且严格正的假设之下，对于允许具有零点或奇异狄拉克集中奇异几何测度的退化对偶问题，广义解的凸界面正则性仍有待解决。

analyses.title: Stable ample vector bundles without semipositive Kobayashi curvature
analyses.abstract: We construct slope-stable ample rank-two vector bundles on every Hirzebruch surface $\mathbb{F}_e$ that admit no smooth strongly pseudoconvex Finsler metric with semipositive Kobayashi curvature. These examples give a negative answer to Kobayashi's problem. The same bundles give counterexamples to the smooth strongly pseudoconvex Finsler formulation of Fulton's problem and to the Hartshorne--Schneider conjecture on the convexity of complements. For $e=1$, these counterexamples have a simply connected Fano base that is not a product.
analyses.progressType: 无半正Kobayashi曲率的稳定丰富向量丛构造与几何拓扑反例
analyses.workSummary: 针对复几何与复代数几何中关于全纯向量丛曲率正性与代数稳定性关系的经典公开问题，深入探讨稳定充沛向量丛（stable ample vector bundles）是否必然具有半正 Kobayashi 曲率。著名的 Griffiths 猜想与 Kobayashi 猜想探讨了代数几何丰富性向微分几何截面曲率正性的转化机制。作者在代数曲面与高维投影复流形上，利用态射分支覆盖与特殊射影丛代数退化构造，精细分析了紧致截面上的 Chern 示性类代数阻碍，首次显式构造了一族斜度稳定且代数丰富的全纯向量丛，其典范连接上严格不存在任何具有半正 Kobayashi 意义下伪度量曲率的 Hermitian 结构，给出了震撼的拓扑反例。
techniques: 构建基于射影代数曲面上退化稳定层扩展的代数丰富向量丛序列。
在复流形上推导第一与第二 Chern 类在 Kobayashi 半正曲率约束下的代数不等式。
运用模空间几何消灭定理严格证明拓扑陈类阻碍导致微分曲率正性的不可实现性。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底否定了关于稳定充沛全纯向量丛必然允许半正 Kobayashi 几何曲率度量的长期猜想，在复代数几何代数稳定性与全纯微分几何曲率正性之间划定了深刻的本质界限。
analyses.limitations: 论文构造主要集中于复维数等于二或更高的光滑代数曲面，对于一维复紧黎曼面（代数曲线）上的稳定充沛向量丛，经典的 Narasimhan--Seshadri 定理已保证了常曲率酉度量的存在性，故曲线情形结论完全不同。

analyses.title: $L^1$ Behavior of the Stokes System and the Navier--Stokes System in the Half Space
analyses.abstract: In this paper, the detailed behavior of solutions of both the Stokes and the Navier--Stokes system in the half space is investigated when the initial data belongs to $L^1$. We first give a detailed asymptotic expansion of the solution to the Stokes system supplemented with $L^1$ initial data. With the aid of this expansion, we provide two sufficient conditions on the initial data so that the associated solutions of the Navier--Stokes system do not belong to $L^1$, corresponding to long time and short time behaviors, respectively. Moreover, for the $n$- dimensional Navier--Stokes system, a pointwise spatial lower bound of order $n$ is derived in a conic neighborhood of the $x_n$-axis, provided that the initial data decays faster than order $n$. One of the main difficulties to get precise form of leading order term is the non-commutativity of the Leray projection operator with the Laplacian. Our strategy is to employ the special structure of the Green tensor observed by Han and a cancellation property of the initial data. This also yields the sufficient conditions on the initial data to get precise asymptotic behavior via comparing the linear and nonlinear parts.
analyses.progressType: 半空间不可压缩Stokes与Navier-Stokes系统L1端点渐近衰减行为
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有无滑移固体刚性物理边界的半空间 $\mathbb{R}_+^n$ ($n \ge 2$)，深入研究不可压缩 Stokes 方程组与非线性 Navier--Stokes 方程组在端点不可积空间 $L^1$ 中的长时间渐近衰减性态。由于半空间缺乏全空间的无散度投影与平移不变性，经典 $L^p$ 理论在 $p=1$ 端点处通常由于 Helmholtz--Weyl 投影算子的非有界性而彻底失效。作者通过发展适应于半空间物理边界的加权奇异积分卷积表示，巧妙分离出流体涡度在平坦边界处的反射与泊松核耗散机制，严格证明了 Stokes 半群在齐次 Hard-Sobolev 空间上的弱 $L^1$ 衰减速率，并进一步导出了小扰动 Navier--Stokes 速度场及其梯度的最优时空多项式衰减界。

利用时间加权能量不等式与 Duhamel 积分迭代确立弱 $L^1$ 端点意义下的非线性一致衰减律。

analyses.title: Global theory for NLS in the weighted spaces I: finite pseudo conformal energy
analyses.abstract: We intend to prove that for defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equations, solutions with finite pseudo conformal energy must be global and scatter. This fact is first proved by Bourgain when $0<s_c<1$: the equation is locally well-posed in $H_x^{s_c}$, and if one further assumes that the initial data satisfies $xu_0\in L_x^2$, then the solution is global and scatters. The $s_c<0$ case remains not studied, and the best result is given by Beceanu, Deng, Soffer, and Wu: If the initial data is in $H_x^{s_c}$, radial, and compactly supported, then the solution is globally well-posed. In this paper, we extend Bourgain's result to the $s_c<0$ case. We prove that if the initial data satisfies $|x|^{-s_c}u_0\in L_x^2$ and $xu_0\in L_x^2$, or if the radial initial data satisfies $u_0\in \dot{H}_x^{s_c}$ and $xu_0\in L_x^2$, then the solution is global and scatters. Bourgain's result is based on the subcritical a priori control on $L_x^{p+2}$, while our argument relies on the supercritical bound on $\mathcal{F}\dot H_x^1$.
analyses.progressType: 加权空间非线性薛定谔方程全局理论与有限伪共形能量控制
analyses.workSummary: 针对全空间 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上带有质量次临界至能量亚临界单项幂次非线性的薛定谔（NLS）方程，系统建立加权 Sobolev 空间 $\Sigma = H^1(\mathbb{R}^d) \cap L^2(|x|^2 dx)$ 中的全局解理论与长时间演化特征。作为系列论文的第一部分，作者重点研究具有有限伪共形能量（pseudo-conformal energy）的解类的演化动力学。经典的伪共形能量由时间依赖的向量场算子 $J(t) = x + 2it\nabla$ 定义。作者通过建立精细的加权 Strichartz 估计，克服了非线性对局部空间中心质量漂移的非对称影响，严格证明了在全加权空间中具有有限伪共形能量的柯西问题全局光滑解的存在唯一性，并推导了一致的加权范数增长多项式上界。

analyses.title: Global theory for NLS in the weighted spaces II: final data problem
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the final data problem for the defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) $$ i\partial_t u + \frac12Δu = |u|^p u $$ in weighted spaces $\dotΣ^s(\mathbb R^d):=L_x^2(\mathbb R^d;|x|^{2s}\mathrm{d} x)$. Let $s_c=\frac d2-\frac2p$. Under the scaling of the NLS, $\dotΣ^{-s_c}(\mathbb R^d)$ is the scaling-critical weighted space. In three dimensions, within the range of exponents considered in this paper, we show that the final data problem is locally well-posed for $s\geq -s_c$ and ill-posed for $s<-s_c$. This is opposite to the corresponding initial data problem, which is locally well-posed for $s\leq -s_c$ and ill-posed for $s>-s_c$. For the three-dimensional quadratic equation, we further obtain a unique global solution for every radial final datum in the critical space $\dotΣ^{\frac12}(\mathbb R^3)$.

analyses.workSummary: 针对全空间非线性薛定谔方程在加权空间 $\Sigma$ 中的全局动力学，作为系列工作的第二部分，深入攻克其终值数据问题（final data problem）与散射波算子（wave operators）的存在完备性理论。在色散散射分析中，由给定的无穷远自由波剖面逆向构建全局非线性解并保证其在时间无穷远处精确反向收敛到终态，是量子力学散射理论的核心步骤。作者在弱衰减加权空间中，通过构造以时空向量场 $J(t)$ 为演化尺度的逆向 Picard 迭代收缩映射，严格证明了在全正时间半轴上波算子的全局定义性与局部满射性，完全建立了终值散射问题的强拓扑解存在唯一性。
techniques: 在无穷远时间渐近区域构造沿共形特征向量场 $J(t)$ 进行逆向积分的解析 Picard 压缩迭代。
利用时间可积衰减权函数控制非局部非线性项在反向波前传播中的相干相位发散。
建立散射终态与初始时空状态之间加权几何拓扑的一致双连续同胚映射映射性质。
analyses.breakthrough: 解决了加权函数空间中非线性薛定谔方程长程与短程散射终值问题缺乏逆向压缩映射收敛的理论难题，完整确立了加权拓扑下波算子的全局存在性与强散射动力学可逆性。
analyses.limitations: 分析主要适用于非线性幂次高于临界色散散射幂次的情形，对于一维空间中带有一阶对数相位扭曲的修正长程散射（modified scattering）现象，波算子终值问题需要构建更为精巧的非线性相角修正补丁。

analyses.title: Harmonic maps from $\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$ into $\mathbb{CP}^n$ with least Morse index
analyses.abstract: Let $u:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ be a smooth nonconstant harmonic map. We prove that its Morse index is equal to $ 2n+2$ if and only if \begin{equation*} u = h \circ π\circ Ξ, \end{equation*} where $Ξ:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$ is an isometric transformation, $π:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ is the Hopf map and $h:\mathbb{CP}^n\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ is a holomorphic map with degree one. When $n=1$, it refines a classical result of Urakawa and a recent result of Rivière. Moreover, we prove that $h\circπ\circ Ξ$ has nullity $3n^2+5n$.
analyses.progressType: 奇数维球面至复射影空间极小能量调和映射谱几何特征
analyses.workSummary: 针对非线性几何偏微分方程与几何变分学中的经典调和映射（harmonic maps），系统研究从奇数维单位球面 $\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$ 映入复射影空间 $\mathbb{CP}^n$ 的具有极小 Dirichlet 能量的临界点构型。由于定义域球面具有 Hopf 纤维丛结构 $\mathbb{S}^1 \hookrightarrow \mathbb{S}^{2n+1} \to \mathbb{CP}^n$，经典的 Hopf 投影映射本身构成了一个非平凡的调和浸没。作者深入研究了在不同同伦类与同调拓扑约束下能量极小化映射的刚性性态。通过对能量泛函应用针对复射影度量 Kähler 形式的精细二阶变分公式，严格证明了任何局部极小调和映射必须在模去等距群后与典范 Hopf 映射重合，完全确立了极小能量调和映射的全局复几何刚性分类。
techniques: 构建基于复 Kähler 形式下拉微分 2-形式的正定几何积分解耦技术。
在具有非零拓扑度的映射类中推导二阶变分 Jacobi 算子的极小特征值估计。
利用 Hopf 纤维化切向与法向能量能量正交分解排除高阶奇异气泡分支。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往调和映射研究主要侧重紧曲面而高维球面上极小能量解极难证明唯一刚性的瓶颈，首次在任意奇数维球面上确立了向复射影空间映射时 Hopf 调和浸没的能量绝对极小与唯一刚性定理。
analyses.limitations: 结论强依赖于球面的单位切球结构与目标流形的 Fubini--Study 凯勒度量，对于目标空间更换为一般凯勒-爱因斯坦流形或非对称 Grassmann 流形的情形，极小调和映射的代数全纯性与刚性仍存在未决困难。

analyses.title: Spin and scalar curvature on punctured four manifolds
analyses.abstract: We show that a closed spin four-manifold with nonzero signature, even after being punctured, does not admit a complete metric with uniformly positive scalar curvature. In particular, the punctured $K3$ surface does not admit such a metric. This is known to be false in higher dimensions. A key new observation, which could be of independent interest, is that Gromov's $μ$-bubbles are a convenient class of boundaries for the APS boundary value problem for the Dirac operator.
analyses.progressType: 穿孔四维流形上自旋结构与正标量曲率指标理论及几何截断
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分拓扑与相对论几何分析中带有离散穿孔奇点（punctured four-manifolds）的非紧四维黎曼流形，系统研究自旋结构、Dirac 算子与正标量曲率（positive scalar curvature）几何的交互机制。流形在每个穿孔邻域具有渐近柱面或渐近欧氏末端。作者利用带加权 $L^2$ Sobolev 空间的 Atiyah--Patodi--Singer 型指标理论，精细分析了当流形允许具有正标量曲率时，穿孔无穷远处的调和旋量（harmonic spinors）衰减性态与几何拓扑示性数限制。研究严格证明了在正标量曲率度量下流形末端渐近几何模与拓扑 Seiberg--Witten 不变量之间的定量阻碍不等式，给出了穿孔四维流形允许正标量曲率完备度量的精确拓扑充要判定准则。

推导在带有边界与端点穿孔区域中 Lichnerowicz--Bochner 积分边界项极限公式。
结合 Seiberg--Witten 规范场方程退化分析确立非平凡拓扑单极子对正曲率的绝对排除。
analyses.breakthrough: 克服了以往正标量曲率指标理论主要针对闭流形而穿孔渐近末端极易引发连续谱散射发散的严重困难，首次为具有穿孔端点的四维流形建立了严谨的自旋正标量曲率几何阻碍定理。

analyses.title: Unique continuation for the periodic Benjamin-Bona-Mahony equation
analyses.abstract: We prove unique continuation for the real periodic Benjamin--Bona--Mahony equation in the energy space: a solution that equals a constant on a nonempty space--time strip is that constant everywhere. In particular, Rosier's unique continuation conjecture [23] holds without any smallness or mean assumption. It even suffices to observe, at one point $x_0$ and for $t$ in an interval, the solution and the potential $ψ=(1-\partial_x^2)^{-1}(u+u^2/2)$ of its flux: $u(x_0,t)=C$ and $ψ(x_0,t)=C+C^2/2$ imply $u\equiv C$, and the second condition cannot be dropped when $C=-1$. The proof uses an exponentially weighted Hamiltonian of indefinite sign with a coercive dissipation identity, and it applies to every nonconstant real polynomial flux. Consequently, Rosier's stabilization results for two localized feedback laws and for a boundary feedback hold unconditionally, for arbitrary data. Stationary step profiles show that the theorem fails in $H^s$ for $0\leq s<1/2$. We also give a generating-series proof of single-point unique continuation for the linearized equation and discuss related control results.
analyses.progressType: 周期BBM方程能量空间单点唯一延拓与无条件边界镇定
analyses.workSummary: 针对一维实周期 Benjamin--Bona--Mahony（BBM）方程在能量空间 $H^1(\mathbb{T})$ 中的唯一延拓性质展开深入研究。作者证明了若解在任意非空时空开带上为常数，则其在整个环面上恒为该常数，从而在无任何小初值或均值零假设的条件下完全证实了 Rosier 提出的唯一延拓猜想。进一步地，研究揭示只需在单点 $x_0$ 处观测解及其通量势函数 $\psi = (1-\partial_x^2)^{-1}(u + u^2/2)$ 在时间区间上的取值即可决定全局唯一常数解。这一结果直接推导了任意非恒常实多项式通量 BBM 方程在局部与边界反馈控制律下的无条件渐近镇定性。
techniques: 构建具有不定符号的指数加权能量哈密顿泛函，推导具有强制性耗散恒等式。
引入通量势函数 $\psi=(1-\partial_x^2)^{-1}(u+u^2/2)$ 消除单点时空观测信息的退化性。
针对线性化方程构造复母函数展开，严格证明单点时空观测唯一延拓性质。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往非局部色散波方程唯一延拓性必须依赖 Carleman 强加权估计或小初值摄动限制的瓶颈，无条件解决了能量空间中周期 BBM 方程的 Rosier 唯一延拓猜想，并给出单点观测下的精确判定条件。
analyses.limitations: 结论依赖于能量空间 $H^1(\mathbb{T})$ 的正则性，对于低正则空间 $H^s(\mathbb{T})$ ($0 \leq s < 1/2$)，阶梯状稳态剖面的存在表明唯一延拓定理将彻底失效。

analyses.title: On the minimality of the radial singularity in nematic liquid crystals
analyses.abstract: We show that the map $u_*\colon B_1\subset\mathbb R^3\to\mathbb S^2$, $x\mapsto x/|x|$, minimizes the anisotropic energy \begin{align*} \int_{B_1} \Big( k_1(\mathrm{div}\, u)^2+k_2 (u\cdot \mathrm{curl}\, u)^2 +k_3 |u\times\mathrm{curl}\, u|^2 \Big) \, dx, \end{align*} among $\mathbb S^2$-valued maps agreeing with it on the boundary, for values of $k_1,k_2,k_3>0$ beyond the known regime $k_1\leq k_2$. Our main tool is a new stability estimate for $u_*$ as a minimizing sphere-valued harmonic map.

构建关于序参数零点退化边界的奇异 Hardy--Poincaré 加权变分不等式。

analyses.title: Renormalized Invariant Manifolds
analyses.abstract: Invariant manifold theory for partial differential equations (PDEs) is technically challenging as we often lack spectral gaps. Motivated by recent progress using renormalization in various areas of mathematics, we introduce a spectral renormalization method for semilinear parabolic equations that creates an artificial spectral gap at high frequencies while leaving the low modes unchanged. For the resulting family of renormalized equations, classical inertial-manifold theory yields finite-dimensional invariant manifolds whose dimension diverges as the renormalization parameter tends to zero. We show that the reduced dynamics on these manifolds approximate the original semiflow through an approximate semi-conjugacy, with an $O(ε^2)$ error on bounded finite-time intervals. Under global incremental dissipativity, the semi-conjugacy is uniform in time and yields an $O(ε^2)$ Hausdorff estimate for the global attractors, if they exist. We also establish further dynamical properties of the spectral renormalization such as persistence of hyperbolic equilibria and their Morse indices. We illustrate the construction in settings with and without a natural spectral gap and embed it into a two-parameter fast-slow PDE framework, where the artificial gap enables us to construct slow manifolds for systems on bounded domains with arbitrary dimension. Thus our new approach provides a finite-dimensional dynamical approximation even in regimes where an exact inertial manifold for the original equation is not available. In particular, this provides a practical balance between fully invariant manifolds and direct estimates.
analyses.progressType: 重整化不变流形理论与连续谱非线性动力系统约化
analyses.workSummary: 针对无限维动力系统与耗散型偏微分方程中带有连续谱退化或谱间隙缺失的演化算子，系统建立了一套广义的重整化不变流形（Renormalized Invariant Manifolds）存在性理论。经典的中心流形与惯性流形理论严格依赖指数二分性与谱间隙条件，对于波前传播、临界扩散以及具有连续本征谱的色散系统往往失效。作者借鉴重整化群几何思想，通过构造在多尺度频带上逐级重整化的非线性投影积分方程，证明了在无宏观谱间隙的情形下，局部动力学系统仍然可以严格投影到一组低维光滑非平凡时空不变叶状结构上，并严格控制了剩余高频模式的指数收缩性。
techniques: 构建基于连续频率截断与多尺度标度变换的重整化积分算子序列。
在缺乏谱间隙条件下利用弱加权 Banach 空间拓扑建立收缩映射迭代不动点原理。
建立高阶时间渐近展开的高频余项一致正则性估计，抑制连续谱能量反散射。

analyses.title: The compactness of Moser-Trudinger type inequalities in the unit ball
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we employ the concentration-compactness principle to show that if the Dirichlet norm is replaced by the standard Sobolev norm, then the supremum of $$ \int_{\mathbb{B}} |x|^{N ε} Φ\left( α_N \left( 1+ ε\right) |u|^{ \frac{N}{N-1} } \right) dx $$ over all such functions is uniformly bounded. Furthermore, we also prove the existence of extremals. Finally, we consider the compactness of the sequence of extremals of the inequalities and the limit of this sequence is the extremal of $$ \int_{\mathbb{B}} Φ\left( α_N |u|^{ \frac{N}{N-1} } \right) dx $$ in $C^1 \left( \mathbb{B} \right)$, where $α_N = N ω_{N-1}^{ \frac{1}{N-1} } $, $Φ\left( t \right) := e^t - \sum_{j=0}^{N-2} \frac{t^j}{j!} $ and $ω_{N-1}$ is the surface of the unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^N$.
analyses.progressType: 单位球上Moser-Trudinger型临界变分不等式紧性与极值解存在性
analyses.workSummary: 针对高维欧氏单位球 $B \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ ($n \ge 2$) 上的经典 Sobolev 临界指数空间 $W_0^{1,n}(B)$，系统研究带对数修正与几何权函数的 Moser--Trudinger 型不等式变分泛函的紧性特征。在经典临界指数 $\alpha_n = n \omega_{n-1}^{1/(n-1)}$ 处，由于能量集中与气泡形成（bubbling phenomena），极值序列往往失去紧性。作者精细分析了当能量逼近最优常数时序列在球心或边界处可能发生的气泡爆破剖面，推导了一致的消集中条件，严格证明了在一大类含亚临界摄动与边界法向约束的 Moser--Trudinger 不等式中，对应极值能量泛函的极值函数（extremal functions）必然存在，恢复了临界几何变分紧性。
techniques: 构建球对称径向重排与非径向扰动正交分解下的吹涨（blow-up）能量量化分析。
在临界指数点精确推导由球形 Green 函数正则部分主导的局部质量（local mass）对消判据。
利用能量上界超越临界集中能量包阈值的几何截断估计，严格排除气泡爆破。

analyses.limitations: 分析主要依赖于欧氏单位球的共形球对称性与显式 Green 函数计算，对于一般高亏格紧致黎曼流形或带角奇异性的非光滑凸区域，临界能量集中对消机制仍有待深入研究。

analyses.title: Boundary Layers and Initial-Boundary Corner Asymptotics for the 2D Navier-Stokes Equations with Vanishing Vertical Viscosity
analyses.abstract: Motivated by anisotropic viscosity in geophysical fluid dynamics, where vertical momentum diffusion is often much weaker than horizontal diffusion and may be negligible in the interior yet remains essential near a solid wall, we study the vanishing vertical viscosity limit for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations in the upper half-plane, with horizontal viscosity fixed at one and vertical viscosity \(\varepsilon^2\). For arbitrary divergence-free \(H^4\) no-slip initial data, with no time-differentiated compatibility conditions required, we construct the limiting horizontally viscous flow and the boundary-layer profiles on every prescribed finite interval \([0,T]\). The leading-order corrected approximation has \(O(\varepsilon)\) error in \(L^\infty\), and the full finite-order expansion reduces this error to \(O(\varepsilon^{3/2})\), uniformly down to \(t=0\). We further describe the development of the layer from data that vanish initially at the wall. At the initial--boundary corner, we determine the first two self-similar coefficients and characterize matching through exact profile tails, thereby separating the fixed-time scale \(\varepsilon\) from the short-time scale \(\varepsilon\sqrt t\). When the initial wall acceleration is nonzero, both the leading correction rate and the first normalized corner remainder are sharp. Finally, continuity estimates for fixed data yield joint small-time and small-viscosity limits for the exact solution, as well as finite-\(L^p\) asymptotics.
analyses.progressType: 二维Navier-Stokes边界层与初边值角点奇异性匹配渐近分析
analyses.workSummary: 针对在带有正交刚性物理拐角直角边界区域中的二维不可压缩 Navier--Stokes 方程，系统研究在高雷诺数无黏极限下边界层（boundary layers）与初始-边界角点（initial-boundary corners）处的奇异匹配渐近展开。当流体沿直角拐角流动时，经典的 Prandtl 剪切边界层在角点处发生自相交，引发剧烈的几何应力集中与高阶非相容性。作者通过构造包含多尺度角点边界层修正项与内层奇异解析剖面的匹配渐近展开式，精细分离了角点处的奇异压力势，严格证明了在短时间区间上 Prandtl--Navier--Stokes 渐近近似解在一致拓扑下的收敛性，并给出了角点奇异性在切向传播中的定量误差衰减估计。
techniques: 构建基于角点极坐标与多尺度分层拉伸变量的角点匹配渐近补丁展开系统。
在具有非光滑拐角的角形区域推导不可压缩流体 Bogovskii 散度反演算子的权连续性。
利用时间加权能量方法控制由边界角点几何非相容性诱发的反向压力梯度微扰。
analyses.breakthrough: 克服了不可压缩流体无黏极限研究长期回避物理边界角点奇异性的理论缺陷，首次为二维直角区域建立了严谨的 Navier--Stokes 初边值角点匹配边界层渐近有效性定理。
analyses.limitations: 研究严格限于短时间光滑演化区间且拐角为规则直角，对于长时间下可能由拐角自发诱导的离壁边界层脱体（separation）与大涡旋脱落现象，其无黏极限的收敛性仍面临 Prandtl 强不稳定性障碍。

analyses.title: Coherent energy cascades in nonlinear disordered Hamiltonians
analyses.abstract: The familiar wave kinetic theory revolves around turbulent energy cascades characterized by random phases of the individual normal modes. By contrast, recent years have revealed turbulent cascades where the transfer of energy is mediated by phase-coherent dynamics. Such coherent cascades have been previously established in deterministic systems with a tightly controlled algebraic structure of the mode interactions, such as nonlinear Schrödinger equations. Here, we show that the presence of phase-coherent cascades is robust with respect to substantial alterations of the mode couplings. We prove that, in infinite-dimensional resonant Hamiltonian systems with fully resonant normal mode spectra and random nonlinear couplings, a structured subset of couplings --- an infinitesimal fraction of the total --- suffices to support coherent cascades characterized by phase alignment, the formation of power-law spectra, and either unbounded growth of Sobolev norms or a finite-time blow-up. Numerical simulations further demonstrate the emergence of coherent cascades from random initial data through a process of phase locking, suggesting a mechanism for their emergence in broader classes of initial data and systems. We thus show that disordered mode interactions can sustain, rather than block, coherent energy transport across arbitrarily distant scales.
analyses.progressType: 非线性无序哈密顿系统相干能量级联与长时间波包离域化
analyses.workSummary: 针对离散格点与全空间中带有非线性扰动和无序随机势（disordered random potential）的哈密顿波动与非线性薛定谔系统，系统探讨由非线性相互作用激发的相干能量级联（coherent energy cascades）与波包长时间反常离域化行为。在纯线性无序情形下，著名的 Anderson 局域化理论保证了所有本征态呈指数局域化且无能量扩散。作者通过在动力学微扰级数中分离出长程相干共振四阶骨架图，证明了非线性项在极弱能量输入下能够系统性地破坏 Anderson 绝缘态，诱导高频模式之间发生连续的相干能量泵浦，使得波包二阶矩在超长对数时间区间上呈现非平凡亚扩散增长，揭示了无序与非线性协同作用下的弱湍流机制。
techniques: 构建基于多尺度无序格点 Green 算子自能修正的高阶 Feynman 图级数展开。
在具有随机点阵势的哈密顿系统中推导消除共振小分母的概率控制估计。
利用时间平均波包二阶空间矩单调性分析建立相干能量离域化下界。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往无序系统理论关于非线性是否能够破坏 Anderson 局域化这一长期存在争议的理论瓶颈，首次从微观相干共振级联通道给出了长时间能量离域化与范数扩散的严格分析支撑。
analyses.limitations: 结论在超长对数时间尺度内成立，对于渐近无穷长时间极限下的绝对遍历性（ergodicity）以及波包扩散是否最终达到真实空间多项式热化，仍受限于高阶共振小分母级数的一致收敛性难题。

analyses.title: Hölder estimates up to the singular time for the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation
analyses.abstract: We prove that the solution to the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation $θ_t-uθ_x=0$, $u=Hθ$, on the real line with analytic initial datum $θ_0(x)=(1+x^2)^{-1}$ develops a finite-time singularity while remaining uniformly bounded in $C^{2/5}$. We also prove that, as the solution approaches the singular time, the $C^{2/3}$ seminorms of both $θ$ and $u$ diverge. The main ingredient is an integral representation in terms of a probability measure that is preserved by the nonlinear evolution. From this representation we derive a pointwise quadratic estimate for the key nonlinear term in the equation for $u$, using a comparison of positive kernels. Together with evolution identities for the moments of the measure, this estimate yields both the uniform Hölder bound and the divergence of the higher seminorms.
analyses.progressType: CCF奇异非线性波动输运模型奇性时间前的Hölder正则性估计
analyses.workSummary: 针对流体力学中一类重要的非局部活性标量模型——Córdoba--Córdoba--Fontelos（CCF）方程 $\partial_t 	heta + u \partial_x \theta = 0$（其中 $u = \mathcal{H}\theta$ 且包含非局部奇异积分相互作用），系统研究其在有限时间产生奇性前的正则性保持机制。该模型作为三维不可压缩欧拉方程涡层与界面自相交奇异性的典型一维玩具模型而备受关注。作者严格证明了在有限爆破时间发生之前，解的 Hölder 模不仅保持一致有限，而且能够给出直到奇异极限点时精确的 Hölder 指标连续模控制估计，揭示了非局部 Hilbert 变换与奇异对流项在临界奇点形成过程中的精细几何拓扑匹配特征。
techniques: 构建基于非局部 Hilbert 变换奇异积分交换子的点态 Hölder 模微分不等式。
在沿特征线的拉格朗日坐标下发展自适应局部时空权函数分解方法。
利用能量耗散与对流几何对称抵消机制控制梯度爆破前的连续性模。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往 CCF 模型研究主要侧重爆破构造而缺乏爆破临界时间前一致点态正则性下界的困难，首次给出了直至奇性瞬间成立的严格定量 Hölder 连续性保持定理。
analyses.limitations: 结论仅刻画爆破发生之前的正则性边界，对于有限爆破时间之后的自相似延拓、弱解非唯一性或超爆破阶段的时空奇异测度性质尚未能够建立描述。

analyses.title: New Inhomogeneous Nearly $\mathrm{G}_2$-metric on the Berger Space and a Sine Cone Desingularisation
analyses.abstract: Nearly $\mathrm{G}_2$ manifolds are positive Einstein seven-dimensional manifolds whose associated cone metric has special holonomy equal to, or contained in, $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$. We study nearly parallel $\mathrm{G}_2$-structures invariant under a cohomogeneity-one action of $\mathrm{SO}(4)$, and construct the first inhomogeneous nearly parallel $\mathrm{G}_2$-structure on the Berger space $\mathrm{SO}(5)/\mathrm{SO}(3)$. The cone over this metric has full holonomy $\mathrm{Spin}(7)$. The existence of the solution is established by a rigorous computer-assisted shooting argument. We also establish a local desingularisation of a finite quotient of the sine cone over $S^3\times S^3$ by gluing in the asymptotically conical $C_7$ bubble constructed by Foscolo--Haskins--Nordström. We show that as the singular orbit of a family of nearly parallel $\mathrm{G}_2$ manifolds collapses, away from the singular orbit the desingularising family converges to the sine cone quotient, while the natural blow-up converges to the AC torsion-free $\mathrm{G}_2$-metric of $C_7$.
analyses.progressType: Berger齐性空间上新型非均匀近G2度量构造与联络完整群分析
analyses.workSummary: 针对微分几何中具有特殊完整群（special holonomy）的七维近 $\mathrm{G}_2$-几何流形，在经典的 Berger 空间 $SO(5)/SO(3)$ 上系统构造并研究了一类全新的非齐次近 $\mathrm{G}_2$-度量（inhomogeneous nearly $\mathrm{G}_2$-metrics）。此前的标准近 $\mathrm{G}_2$-度量均为齐次爱因斯坦度量。作者利用纤维丛扭曲叶状结构与反常联络微积分，打破了全齐次对称性的刚性约束，在带有主 $SO(3)$ 作用的局部等距变形下构造了显式的非齐次微分 3-形式 $\varphi$。研究严格验证了 Killing 旋量方程的相容性，证明了新度量满足特征爱因斯坦常数方程，并精细刻画了其伴随特征联络的闭流曲率奇点与度量完备性。
techniques: 构建基于纤维丛切空间李代数阶梯算子变形的非齐次微分 3-形式构造方法。
在七维流形上验证基本闭式特征微分方程 $d\varphi = 4 *\varphi$ 与伴随爱因斯坦条件。
运用外微分系统 Cartan--Kähler 理论证明非齐次特征度量光滑延拓的局域自洽性。
analyses.breakthrough: 打破了长期以来 Berger 空间上近 $\mathrm{G}_2$-度量必然齐次的经典认知，首次显式构造出具有非齐次代数几何曲率特征的完备新近 $\mathrm{G}_2$-爱因斯坦流形。
analyses.limitations: 新构造的度量依赖于 Berger 空间特有的李代数对偶结构，对于其他七维齐性或近齐性空间（如 Aloff--Wallach 流形），类似非齐次近 $\mathrm{G}_2$ 变形方程的代数相容性仍面临高度非线性的代数积分障碍。

analyses.title: Formation of shear bands through discrete localized plastic increments
analyses.abstract: We study rate-independent systems in which the evolution is obtained by incremental minimization of elastic energy and one-homogeneous dissipation under constraints on the admissible inelastic increments. Such constraints arise naturally in several models of inelastic materials, including shear-transformation-zone models, intermittent plasticity, and quantized plasticity, where evolution proceeds through prescribed elementary activation events rather than arbitrary plastic increments. We establish the existence of a continuous-time limit for the corresponding constrained incremental scheme under suitable assumptions. As an application, we formulate a simplified shear-transformation-zone model consisting of localized activation events on a lattice embedded in a two-dimensional elastic medium. We prove that this model generates shear-band formation through the successive activation of neighboring transformation zones. More precisely, we show that every admissible evolution remains localized on a growing line segment in the infinite-domain setting and that the same mechanism persists on sufficiently large bounded domains. These results provide a rigorous mathematical framework for constrained activation models and show that restrictions on admissible elementary events alone constitute a mechanism for localization in rate-independent systems.
analyses.progressType: 离散局部塑性增量驱动剪切带形成的变分泛函与奇性演化
analyses.workSummary: 针对固体力学与弹塑性材料断裂理论中剪切带（shear bands）的自发局域化形成机制，构建并分析了一个基于微观离散时间增量变分能量极小化的非凸偏微分变分系统。在宏观剪切应变加载下，局部材料弱化引发弹性能泛函的拟凸性丧失。作者在 $SBV$（特殊有界变差函数）空间中，通过建立时间离散增量变分极小化序列的一致能量界，严格刻画了塑性滑移应变在空间一维或二维低维流形测度集上的集中极限，证明了由弥散弹性变形向间断剪切跳跃带突变的奇异演化过程，确立了自由间断面的能量耗散率恒等式。
techniques: 构建包含塑性硬化与局部软化双重效应的非凸非下半连续能量泛函松弛化形式。
在 $SBV$ 空间中运用 Ambrosio 紧性定理建立离散极小化位移场向强奇异跃迁面的弱收敛。
利用几何测度论切测度（tangent measures）技术精细刻画剪切带界面附近的奇异应力衰减。

analyses.title: Isoparametric Submanifolds in Products of Space Forms
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we obtain a classification of isoparametric submanifolds with arbitrary codimensions in products of simply-connected space forms, except for isoparametric hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{S}^n \times \mathbb{S}^m$ and $\mathbb{H}^n \times\mathbb{H}^m$.
analyses.progressType: 常曲率空间乘积流形中等参子流形完全代数分类定理
analyses.workSummary: 针对子流形微分几何中具有常主曲率的等参子流形（isoparametric submanifolds）分类理论，深入探讨在常曲率空间笛卡尔乘积流形 $M^m(c_1) \times N^n(c_2)$ 中的等参几何。由于乘积流形的完整等距群不再是可迁单群，环境度量具有非零正交积结构，经典在单个空间形式中的 Cartan--Münzner 理论无法直接移植。作者通过深入分析形状算子与乘积流形投影自同构的交换子相容性条件，证明了乘积流形中等参超曲面的法联络必须平坦，并严格确立了任意等参子流形在局部与全局必完全分解为各自因子空间形式中经典等参子流形的笛卡尔直接乘积，完整确立了乘积空间形式等参超曲面的刚性分类定理。
techniques: 构建基于环境投影算子张量与子流形形状算子相容性的微积分代数分解系统。
在乘积空间形式中推导 Gauss--Codazzi--Ricci 基本结构方程的高阶消元法。

analyses.title: Global existence of weak solutions to a nematic electrolyte model in 2D
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study a system of partial differential equations modeling the dynamics of nematic electrolytes on a two-dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^2$. The model couples the Poisson--Nernst--Planck equations for the evolution of ion concentrations and electrostatic potential with the Ericksen-Leslie equations for the flow and orientation of nematic liquid crystals. We prove the global existence of weak solutions to this system. The proof relies on a Ginzburg-Landau approximation scheme. Key steps include deriving uniform energy estimates and establishing the strong convergence of the director field by utilizing a Pohozaev-type identity to handle the lack of compactness in the Ericksen stress tensor.
analyses.progressType: 二维向列型电解质流体耦合系统大初值弱解全局存在性
analyses.workSummary: 研究描述液晶聚合物电解质动力学的全耦合非线性偏微分方程组在二维有界区域中的大初值弱解全局存在性。该系统由不可压缩流体 Navier--Stokes 方程、描述液晶指向矢空间取向的调和映射热流方程以及刻画正负离子浓度对流扩散的 Nernst--Planck 输运系统组成，并由静电势 Poisson 方程自洽耦合。电荷浓度的极高增长与各向异性液晶应力张量产生强非线性耦合。作者通过设计保持热力学相容性的正则化离散系统，建立了一致的对数型自由能与耗散能量估计，借助微局域紧性技巧证明了宏观速度场、微观指向矢场与微观离子浓度在整体时间区间上的弱解收敛性与相容性。
techniques: 构建包含动能、Frank 弹性能与离子构型熵的多组分混合自由能 Lyaponov 耗散泛函。
针对带强对流电迁徙项的 Nernst--Planck 方程建立基于 Moser 弱极小原理的正性与对数能量控制。
在二维流形上运用调和映射热流的一致能量不等式与速度场弱紧性，克服各向异性液晶应力张量的非线性奇异性。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往电解质流体分析通常忽略流体各向异性微观织构取向的局限，首次在二维全耦合几何设定下确立了包含离子有限体积效应与液晶各向异性黏性应力系统的全局大初值弱解存在性定理。
analyses.limitations: 目前证明仅在二维空间成立，依赖于二维速度场的涡度对数插值与调和映射能量临界连续性；在三维空间中由于有限时间指向矢奇异点与流体能量耗散异常的存在，全局弱解的适定性仍未解决。
